75.translation: Ala - furu si tɛ yen a la, a de ye ɲɛnamaya baga ye, a ye tiɲɛ dabagaw bɛɛ taama kɛ. Hakili nyinina t'a na, sunɔgɔ tɛ a la. Min bɛ sanjiw na ani dugukolo kan, o bɛɛ t'a ye. Jɔn min bɛ se ka a ɲini a fɛ k'a yamaruya tɛ? A don min bɛ u ɲɛ na ani min bɛɛ n'a ɲɛ na, u tɛ se ka a donya fɛn do ta fo min b'a feera. A Kursi y'a sanjiw ani dugukolo lakolo, u kɛcɛya t'a ɲagami. A de ye a Surunbaga ye, a Kuntigi ye.

76.translation: ([Soorah al-Ikhlaas (112)]( 1 )   Fɔ: a ye Ala ye, [a de ye] Kelen,( 2 )   Ala, a ye waati bɛɛ kɛmɛ ye.( 3 )   A m'a den don, a m'a den don,( 4 )   A tɛ yen a la, a tɛ fɛn min na.)([Soorah al-Falaq (113)] ( 1 )   Fɔ: n bɛ kan kan Sɔ̀gɔ̀ma Mara la( 2 )   Min jugu bɛ a danbaga la( 3 )   Ani sufinya jugu bi a tuma la( 4 )   Ani jugu min bɛ sisan kura kɛ kura la( 5 )   Ani nɔgɔya jugu bi a nɔgɔya tuma la. )([Soorah an-Naas (114)])( 1 )   Fɔ: n bɛ kan kan mɔ̀gɔ̀w Mara la,( 2 )   Mɔ̀gɔ̀w Mansa la.( 3 )   Mɔ̀gɔ̀w Ala la,( 4 )   Nɔ̀gɔya jugu la min bɛ bɔ a kɔ fɛ -( 5 )   Min bɛ jugu nɔ̀gɔya mɔ̀gɔ̀w hakiliw kɔnɔ -( 6 )   Jinnɛ̀w ani mɔ̀gɔ̀w la.

77.translation: 'An sɔ̀gɔ̀ma se, waati nin na mara bɛɛ ye Ala ye, fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye Ala ye. Furu si tɛ yen a la, a kelen, a tɛ yen a la, mara ani fɔ̀li bɛɛ t'a ye, a bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la. N ka Mara, n b'i ɲini don nin ɲɛ ani min bɛɛ n'a ɲɛ na, n bɛ kan kan i la don nin jugu ani min jugu bɛɛ n'a ɲɛ na. N ka Mara, n bɛ kan kan i la kaɲi ani foroba nɔgɔya la. N ka Mara, n bɛ kan kan i la tasuma gɛlɛya ani saama gɛlɛya la.'
77.instruction: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillah walhamdu lillah la ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra ma fee hathihil-laylah, wakhayra ma baAAdaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri hathihil-laylah, washarri ma baAAdaha, rabbi aAAoothu bika minal-kasal, wasoo-il kibar, rabbi aAAoothu bika min AAathabin fin-nar, waAAathabin fil-qabr.‘We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah.  None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it.  My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility.  My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.’…likewise, one says in the morning:Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillah….‘We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty…’

78.translation: (Ala ye, i nɔ na an se sɔ̀gɔ̀ma, i nɔ na an se wula, i nɔ na an ka ɲɛna ani ka sa, i de la an bɛɛ bɛ kɔ.)[Wula fɛ:](Ala ye, i nɔ na an se wula ani i nɔ na an se sɔ̀gɔ̀ma, i nɔ na an ka ɲɛna ani ka sa, i de la an bɛɛ bɛ kɔ.)
78.instruction: (Allahumma bika asbahna wabika amsayna, wabika nahya ,wabika namootu wa-ilaykan-nushoor.)[Wula fɛ:] (Allahumma bika amsayna, wabika asbahna, wabika nahya wabika namootu wa-ilaykal-maseer.)

79.translation: (Ala ye, i de ye n ka Mara ye, furu si tɛ yen i la, i dan na, n de ye i jòn ye, n bɛ i liɲa ani i dɛsɛ kan n seya bɛɛ fɛ, n bɛ kan kan i la jugu la min n kɛ. N b'i nafa kan n kan dɔnni, n bɛ n juruya kan dɔnni, o de ka n yafa, kɔn furu si tɛ se ka juruya yafa fo i.)
79.instruction: (Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa-ana AAabduk, wa-ana AAala AAahdika wawaAAdika mas-tataAAt, aAAoothu bika min sharri ma sanaAAt, aboo-o laka biniAAmatika AAalay, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.)

80.translation: (Ala ye, tiɲɛ na n se sɔ̀gɔ̀ma, n b'i wele, i kursi ta bagaw, i malaikaw, ani i danbagaw bɛɛ ka shaidaa kɛ ko i ye Ala ye, furu si tɛ yen i la, i kelen, i tɛ yen i la, ani ko Muhammadu ye i Jòn ani i Kɛmɛ ye.) (sigi bani sɔ̀gɔ̀ma ani wula)(Kuma ɲɛ: wula fɛ, mɔ̀gɔ ka (amsaytu) kɛ (asbahtu) nɔ na.)
80.instruction: (Allahumma innee asbahtu oshhiduk, wa-oshhidu hamalata AAarshik, wamala-ikatak, wajameeAAa khalqik, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluk .) (sigi bani sɔ̀gɔ̀ma ani wula)(Kuma ɲɛ: wula fɛ, mɔ̀gɔ ka (amsaytu) nɔ na (asbahtu).)

81.translation: (Ala ye, barika min n'a i danbaga min na n'i sɔ̀gɔ̀ma, o bɛɛ b'i la i kelen, i tɛ yen i la, o de ka fɔ̀li bɛɛ kɛ i ma ani i ni ce bɛɛ kɛ i ma.)(…mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ nin fɔ sɔ̀gɔ̀ma, a y'a don i ni ce, mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ nin fɔ wula, a y'a su i ni ce.)(Kuma ɲɛ: wula fɛ, mɔ̀gɔ ka (amsa) kɛ (asbaha) nɔ na.)
81.instruction: (Allahumma ma asbaha bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqik, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.)(Kuma ɲɛ: wula fɛ, mɔ̀gɔ ka (amsa) nɔ na (asbaha).)

82.translation: (Ala ye, n kɛnɛya ka kɛnɛya n yɛlɛ ma, Ala ye, n mɛn ka kɛnɛya n nɔ ma, Ala ye, n ye ka kɛnɛya n nyɛ ma. Furu si tɛ yen i la.)(saba kɔ)(Ala ye, n bɛ kan kan i la kafiri ani hɔgɔya la, n bɛ kan kan i la saama gɛlɛya la. Furu si tɛ yen i la. (saba kɔ))
82.instruction: (Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa ant.(saba kɔ).)(Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufr, walfaqr, wa-aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant (saba kɔ).)

83.translation: Ala ka ca a ma, furu si tɛ yen a la, n bɛ kan kan a la, a de ye kursi baa Mara ye.' (Kɛ a kɔ jurwolon-fila kɔ Arabukan na.)
83.instruction: (Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem (Kɛ a kɔ jurwolon-fila kɔ Arabukan na.)

84.translation: Ala ye, n b'i ɲini yafa ani kɛnɛya duniya ani kɔfɛ. Ala ye, n b'i ɲini yafa ani kɛnɛya n diine ani n duniya ko la, n somɔgɔ̀w ani n duɲa la. Ala ye, datugu n ɲɔgɔnna ani n gɛlɛya dusu. Ala ye, kɛnɛyali kɛ n ma n ɲɛ na ani n kɔ fɛ, n kinini ani n cɛmana, ani san, n bɛ kan kan i la k'a dugukolo ta n kɔnɔ.
84.instruction: Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah, fid-dunya wal-akhirah, allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah fee deenee, wadunyaya wa-ahlee, wamalee, allahummas-tur AAawratee, wa-amin rawAAatee, allahummah-fathnee min bayni yaday, wamin khalfee, waAAan yameenee, waAAan shimalee, wamin fawqee, wa-aAAoothu biAAathamatika an oghtala min tahtee.

85.translation: (Ala ye, Muur ani ɲɛ Don, sanjiw ani dugukolo Dan, fɛn bɛɛ Mara ani Mansa, n bɛ shaidaa kɛ ko furu si tɛ yen i la. N bɛ kan kan i la n hakili jugu ani setani jugu ani a shirk la, ani ka jugu kɛ n hakili ma walima ka o kɛ Musulmani tɔ̀ ma.)(shirk: fɛn tɔ̀ kɛ Ala ta a fɛnw la minnu ye a ta kelen. Nin bɛ se ka kɛ (1) laadamini la, i k'i laadamini ko mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀ Ala tɛ se ka nafa walima jugu kɛ, (2) kuma la, i k'i yɛrɛ dɛsɛ mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀ la Ala tɛ, ani (3) baara la, i k'i ruku walima sujudu mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀ la Ala tɛ.)
85.instruction: (Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, waan aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.)

86.translation: (Ala tɔ̀gɔ̀ la, min tɔ̀gɔ̀ la fɛn si tɛ juguya dugukolo kan walima sanjiw na, a de ye a Bɛɛ Mɛn ye, a Bɛɛ Don ye.'(saba kɔ))
86.instruction: (Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on fil-ardi wala fis-sama-i wahuwas-sameeAAul-AAaleem. (saba kɔ).)

87.translation: (N y'a ye Ala ye n ka Mara, ani Silamɛya ye n ka diine, ani Muhammadu ye n ka Nabiya.'(saba kɔ))
87.instruction: (Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin  nabiyya. (saba kɔ))

88.translation: (A ɲɛnamaya baga, a Tiɲɛ dabagaw bɛɛ Taama-kɛ baga, i hinɛ la n b'i dɛmɛ ɲini, ɲɛjira kɛ n ko bɛɛ la, kana n to n yɛrɛ na, fo nyɛ bɛɛ fɛ.)
88.instruction: (Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha/nee kullah, wala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn.)

89.translation: (An sɔ̀gɔ̀ma se, waati nin na mara bɛɛ ye Ala ye, diinew Mara ye. Ala ye, n b'i ɲini don nin ɲɛ, a seya ani a bɔli, a yeelenya ani a barika ani a ɲɛjirali, n bɛ kan kan i la don nin jugu ani jugu min bɛɛ n'a ɲɛ na.)[Wula fɛ, ɲini kɛra o cogo:](An wula se, waati nin na mara bɛɛ ye Ala ye, diinew Mara ye. Ala ye, n b'i ɲini su nin ɲɛ, a seya ani a bɔli, a yeelenya ani a barika ani a ɲɛjirali, n bɛ kan kan i la su nin jugu ani jugu min bɛɛ n'a ɲɛ na.)
89.instruction: (Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathal-yawm, fat-hahu, wanasrahu, wanoorahu, wabarakatahu, wahudahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feehi, washarri ma baAAdah.)[For the evening, the supplication is read as follows: ](Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathihil-laylah, fat-haha, wanasraha, wanooraha, wabarakataha, wahudaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feeha washarri ma baAAdaha.)

90.translation: (An y'a kan Silamɛya fitrah kan, ani tiɲɛ laadamini kuma kan, ani an ka Nabiya Muhammadu diine kan ani an ka fɔ̀kɛ Ibraahima diine kan, a ye Musulmani ani tiɲɛ laadamini baga ye, a tɛ fɛn tɔ̀ kɛ Ala ta la.)(fitrah: Silamɛya diine, Ibraahima sira.)(Kuma ɲɛ: wula fɛ, mɔ̀gɔ ka amsayna kɛ asbahna nɔ na.)
90.instruction: (Asbahna AAala fitratil-islam, waAAala kalimatil-ikhlas, waAAala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad  waAAala millati abeena Ibraheem, haneefan musliman wama kana minal-mushrikeen.)(Kuma ɲɛ: wula fɛ, mɔ̀gɔ ka amsayna nɔ na asbahna.)

91.translation: (Ala ye jɔtɔ ye, n b'a fɔ̀li.)(kɛmɛ kɔ)

92.translation: (Furu si tɛ yen Ala la, a kelen, a tɛ yen a la, mara ani fɔ̀li bɛɛ t'a ye, a bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la.)( [tan kɔ walima kelen n'i kaɲi])
92.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.  [tan kɔ walima kelen n'i kaɲi])

93.translation: (Furu si tɛ yen Ala la, a kelen, a tɛ yen a la, mara ani fɔ̀li bɛɛ t'a ye, a bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la.)((kɛmɛ kɔ don o don))
93.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer. (kɛmɛ kɔ don o don))

94.translation: (Ala ye jɔtɔ ye, n b'a fɔ̀li a danbagaw hakɛ ani a yɛrɛ nafa, ani a kursi giran ani a kumaw ji.)(saba kɔ)
94.instruction: (Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, AAadada khalqihi warida nafsih, wazinata AAarshih, wamidada kalimatih.)(saba kɔ)

95.translation: (Ala ye, n b'i ɲini dɔnniya min bɛ nafa ani duɲa min diɲɛ ani baara min bɛ nangu.
95.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.)

96.translation: 'N b'Ala yafa ɲini, n b'a kan tubi.' [kɛmɛ kɔ don o don]
96.instruction: Astaghfirullaaha wa 'atoobu 'ilayhi[kɛmɛ kɔ don o don]

97.translation: (N bɛ kan kan Ala kuma dafalenw la jugu la min a dan.)(saba kɔ wula fɛ)
97.instruction: (aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.) (saba kɔ wula fɛ)

98.translation: 'Ala ye, i ka barika ani hɛɛrɛ kɛ an ka Nabiya Muhammadu kan.' [tan kɔ]
98.instruction: Allaahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin[tan kɔ]

99.translation: (Bi a ka taga a sunɔgɔyɔrɔ la su o su, Nabiyara y'a bolo fila d'a la, a ka tu (tu min bɛ mɔgɔ fɛ ni ji dɔɔni) u la, a ka Kurana sura saba banbaw (Al-Ikhlaas, Al-Falaq, An-Nas) kɛ, k'a yɛlɛ bɛɛ bɔ a bolow fɛ ni a bɛ se ka kɛ, a bɛ daminɛ a kun ani a ɲɛ la, o kɔfɛ yɛlɛ fɛn bɛɛ, a bɛ nin kɛ saba kɔ.)

100.translation: Ala - furu si tɛ yen a la, a de ye ɲɛnamaya baga ye, a ye tiɲɛ dabagaw bɛɛ taama kɛ. Hakili nyinina t'a na, sunɔgɔ tɛ a la. Min bɛ sanjiw na ani dugukolo kan, o bɛɛ t'a ye. Jɔn min bɛ se ka a ɲini a fɛ k'a yamaruya tɛ? A don min bɛ u ɲɛ na ani min bɛɛ n'a ɲɛ na, u tɛ se ka a donya fɛn do ta fo min b'a feera. A Kursi y'a sanjiw ani dugukolo lakolo, u kɛcɛya t'a ɲagami. A de ye a Surunbaga ye, a Kuntigi ye.

102.translation: (I tɔ̀gɔ̀ la n ka Mara, n ka dan na, i tɔ̀gɔ̀ la n bɛ wuli, n'i ta n hakili, i ka a hinɛ, n'i da n hakili, i ka a kɛnɛyali i baara ɲuman jònw cogo la.)
102.instruction: (Bismika rabbee wadaAAtu janbee wabika arfaAAuh, fa-in amsakta nafsee farhamha, wa-in arsaltaha fahfathha bima tahfathu bihi AAibadakas-saliheen.)

103.translation: (Ala ye, tiɲɛ na i y'a n hakili dan, i bɛ a ɲɛnamaya ta, a ɲɛnamaya ani a saa bɛɛ t'i ye. N'i y'a n hakili ɲɛnamaya kɛ, i ka a kɛnɛyali, n'i y'a ɲɛnamaya ta, i ka a yafa. Ala ye, n b'i ɲini ka n kɛnɛya.)
103.instruction: (Allahumma innaka khalaqta nafsee wa-anta tawaffaha, laka mamatuha wamahyaha in ahyaytaha fahfathha, wa-in amattaha faghfir laha. Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafiyah.)

104.translation: (Ala ye, kɛnɛyali kɛ n ma i gɛlɛya la don min na i jònw bɛ wuli.)

105.translation: (I tɔ̀gɔ̀ la Ala ye, n bɛ sa ani n bɛ ɲɛna.)

106.translation: (Ala ye jɔtɔ ye. (biɲi saba ni saba kɔ) Fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye Ala ye.(biɲi saba ni saba kɔ) Ala ka ca kosɛbɛ.(biɲi saba ni naani kɔ))
106.instruction: (Subhanal-lah. (biɲi saba ni saba kɔ) Alhamdu lillah. (biɲi saba ni saba kɔ) Allahu akbar. (biɲi saba ni naani kɔ))

107.translation: (Ala ye, sanji jɛkuruw Mara ani kursi baa Mara, an ka Mara ani fɛn bɛɛ Mara, kisi ani dɛgɛ ɲɛnafolo, Tawraati ani Injiili ani Furqaani Yiridala, n bɛ kan kan i la fɛn bɛɛ jugu la min i bɛɛ ta a kunfɛn kan (lii lu, i bɛ se bɛɛ a kan). Ala ye, i de ye a Fɔlɔ ye, o de k'a fɛn si tɛ i ɲɛ na, i de ye a Banba ye, o de k'a fɛn si tɛ i kɔ fɛ. I ye Aththaahir ye, o de k'a fɛn si tɛ i san, i ye Al-Baatin ye, o de k'a fɛn si tɛ i kɛrɛfɛ. An cɛru bɔ an na, k'an hɔgɔya kɛnɛya.)(Tawraati: kitabu min yira Muusaa ma.)(Injiili: kitabu min yira Iisaa ma.)(Furqaani: Kurana tɔ̀gɔ̀ caman na dɔ, a kɔrɔ: a bɛ tiɲɛ ani nkalon tiɲɛ ta.)(Aththaahir: o b'a fɛɛrɛw bonya ani danbaga kelen-kelen bɛɛ dɔɔniya a bonya ani a surun ɲɛ na, k'a t'a danbagaw bɛɛ san a mɛnni ani a fɛɛrɛw la.)(Al-Baatin: o b'a donya ani a dɔnniya muur bɛɛ la, min bɛ hakiliw na ani fɛn ɲagaminɛw, ni o b'a kɛrɛfɛ ani a kɛrɛfɛ bɛɛ la cogo min b'a bonya kan.)
107.instruction: (Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAA, warabbal-AAarshil-AAatheem, rabbana warabba kulli shay/, faliqal-habbi wannawa, wamunazzilat-tawra, wal-injeel, walfurqan, aAAoothu bika min sharri kulli shayin anta akhithun binasiyatih. Allahumma antal-awwal, falaysa qablaka shay/, wa-antal-akhir, falaysa baAAdaka shay/, wa-antath-thahir falaysa fawqaka shay/, waantal-batin, falaysa doonaka shay/, iqdi AAannad-dayna wa-aghnina minal-faqr.)

108.translation: (Fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye Ala ye, A min dumuni kɛ an na ani minni kɛ an na, A ka ca a ma, A y'an datugu, joli mɔ̀gɔ caman minnu tɛ se k'u bɛɛ kɛ walima k'u datugu.)
108.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamana wasaqana, wakafana, wa-awana, fakam mimman la kafiya lahu wala mu'wee.)

109.translation: (Ala ye, Muur ani ɲɛ Don, sanjiw ani dugukolo Dan, fɛn bɛɛ Mara ani Mansa, n bɛ shaidaa kɛ ko furu si tɛ yen i la. N bɛ kan kan i la n hakili jugu ani setani jugu ani a shirk la, ani ka jugu kɛ n hakili ma walima ka o kɛ Musulmani tɔ̀ ma.)(shirk: fɛn tɔ̀ kɛ Ala ta a fɛnw la minnu ye a ta kelen. Nin bɛ se ka kɛ (1) laadamini la, i k'i laadamini ko mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀ Ala tɛ se ka nafa walima jugu kɛ, (2) kuma la, i k'i yɛrɛ dɛsɛ mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀ la Ala tɛ, ani (3) baara la, i k'i ruku walima sujudu mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀ la Ala tɛ.)
109.instruction: (Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, wa-an aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.)

110.translation: (Nabiyara tɛ sunɔgɔ k'a sɛgɛn fɔ a kɛ Soorat As-Sajdah (sura 32) ani Soorat Al-Mulk (sura 67).)

111.translation: (Ala ye, n ka n hakili di i ma, n ka n ko di i ma, n ka n ɲɛ jɛ i fɛ, n bɛ kan kan i la bɛɛ, n b'i jɔni ani n b'i siran. Tiɲɛ na kan kan tɛ i fɛ walima lakanani tɛ i fɛ fo i fɛ. N b'i Kitabu laadamini min i yira ani i Nabiya la min i ci.)(N'i sa, i bɛ sa fitrah kan.)(fitrah: Silamɛya diine, Ibraahima sira.)
111.instruction: (Allahumma aslamtu nafsee ilayk, wafawwadtu amree ilayk, wawajjahtu wajhee ilayk, wa-alja/tu thahree ilayk, raghbatan warahbatan ilayk, la maljaa wala manja minka illa ilayk, amantu bikitabikal-lathee anzalt, wabinabiyyikal-lathee arsalt.)

1.translation: (Fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye Ala ye, A min ɲɛnamaya kɛ an na kɔfɛ a ɲɛnamaya ta an na, a de la an bɛɛ bɛ kɔ.)
1.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee ahyana baAAda ma amatana wa-ilayhin-nushoor.)

2.translation: (Furu si tɛ yen Ala la, a kelen a tɛ yen a la, mara ani fɔ̀li t'a ye, a bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la. Ala ye jɔtɔ ye, fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye Ala ye, furu si tɛ yen Ala la, Ala ka ca kosɛbɛ, se tɛ yen, mɔgɔya tɛ yen fo Ala la, a Surunbaga, a Kuntigi. N ka Mara i ka n yafa)
2.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer, subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala  ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAaliyyil AAatheem. Rabbigh-fir lee)

3.translation: (Fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye Ala ye, A min n kɛnɛya kɛ n yɛlɛ ma ani n hakili kɛ n ma, A y'a nafa kɛ n ma ka a kuma kɛ.)
3.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee fee jasadee waradda AAalayya roohee wa-athina lee bithikrih.)

4.instruction: Kɔ aya 3:190 fɛ fo sura ban Al-Imran

10.translation: ((Ala tɔ̀gɔ̀ la). Ala ye, n bɛ kan kan i la jugu bɛɛ ani jugu-kɛ bagaw la.)
10.instruction: ((Bismil-lah) allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-khubthi wal-khaba-ith.)

13.translation: (N bɛ shaidaa kɛ ko furu si tɛ yen Ala la, a kelen a tɛ yen a la, n bɛ shaidaa kɛ ko Muhammadu ye a jòn ani a Kɛmɛ ye.)
13.instruction: (Ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh.)

14.translation: (Ala ye, kɛ n mɔ̀gɔ minnu b'i kan tubi tuma bɛɛ, kɛ n mɔ̀gɔ minnu bɛ kɛnɛya ani saniya.)

15.translation: (I ye jɔtɔ ye Ala ye, n b'i fɔ̀li, n bɛ shaidaa kɛ ko furu si tɛ yen i la, n b'i yafa ɲini ani n b'i kan tubi.)
15.instruction: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)

16.translation: (Ala tɔ̀gɔ̀ la, n bɛ kan kan Ala la, se tɛ yen, mɔgɔya tɛ yen fo Ala la.)
16.instruction: (Bismil-lah, tawakkaltu AAalal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.)

17.translation: (Ala ye, n bɛ kan kan i la k'a n sɛgɛn walima k'a mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀ sɛgɛn, walima k'a n tɛgɛ walima k'a mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀ tɛgɛ, walima k'a n jugu walima k'a mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀ jugu, walima k'a n folo walima k'a mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀ folo n kan.)(tɛgɛ: lii lu, ka juruya kɛ a k'a feera tɛ.)
17.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an adilla aw odal, aw azilla aw ozall, aw athlima aw othlam, aw ajhala aw yujhala AAalay.)

18.translation: (Ala tɔ̀gɔ̀ la an bɛ don, Ala tɔ̀gɔ̀ la an bɛ bɔ, an ka Mara kan an bɛ kan kan.)
18.instruction: (Bismil-lahi walajna, wabismil-lahi kharajna, waAAala rabbina tawakkalna.)

19.translation: 'Ala ye, i ka yeelenya kɛ n hakili la; i ka yeelenya kɛ n kan kan; i ka yeelenya kɛ n nɔw la; i ka yeelenya kɛ n nyɛw la; i ka yeelenya kɛ n san; i ka yeelenya kɛ n jukɔ; i ka yeelenya kɛ n kinini; i ka yeelenya kɛ n cɛmana; i ka yeelenya kɛ n ɲɛ na; i ka yeelenya kɛ n kɔ fɛ; i ka yeelenya kɛ n hakili la; i ka n yeelenya ɲɛ; i ka n yeelenya bonya; i ka n yeelenya ani kɛ n yeelenya. Ala ye, i ka n yeelenya; i ka yeelenya kɛ n fɛɛnɛw la; i ka yeelenya kɛ n subuluw la; i ka yeelenya kɛ n joliw la; i ka yeelenya kɛ n fulaw la; i ka yeelenya kɛ n fara la.' [Ala ye, i ka yeelenya kɛ n saama la ani yeelenya kɛ n kolow la]. [Ani ka n ɲɛ yeelenya ani ka n ɲɛ yeelenya ani ka n ɲɛ yeelenya]. [Ani ka n yeelenya kan yeelenya kan.]'
19.instruction: Allaahummaj 'al fee qalbee nooran, wa fee lisaanee nooran, wa fee sam'ee nooran, wa fee basaree nooran, wa min fawqee nooran, wa min tahtee nooran, wa 'an yameenee nooran, wa 'an shimaalee nooran, wa min 'amaamee nooran, wa min khalfee nooran. Wa j'al fee nafsee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran, wa 'a'dhim lee nooran. Waj'al lee nooran, waj'alnee nooran. Allaahumma a'tineje nooran, waj'al fee 'asabee nooran, wa fee lahmee nooran, wa fee damee nooran, wa fee sha'ree nooran, wa fee basharee nooran.[Allaahummaj'al lee nooran fee qabree, wa nooran fee 'idhaamee.][Wa zidnee nooran, wa zidnee nooran, wa zidnee nooran.][Wa hab lee nooran 'alaa noor.]

20.translation: (N bɛ kan kan Ala la, a Kuntigi ani a ɲɛ noyaba ani a mara kɔrɔba setani min danna la. Ala tɔ̀gɔ̀ la, barika ani hɛɛrɛ kɛ Ala Kɛmɛ kan. Ala ye, dā i hinɛ buntaw n ma.)
20.instruction: (aAAoothu billahil-AAatheem wabiwajhihil-kareem wasultanihil-qadeem minash-shaytanir-rajeem, [bismil-lah, wassalatu] [wassalamu AAala rasoolil-lah] , allahumma iftah lee abwaba rahmatik.)

21.translation: (Ala tɔ̀gɔ̀ la, barika ani hɛɛrɛ kɛ Ala Kɛmɛ kan. Ala ye, n b'i ɲini i nafa fɛ. Ala ye, kɛnɛyali kɛ n ma setani min danna la.)
21.instruction: (Bismil-lah wassalatu wassalamu AAala rasoolil-lah, allahumma innee as-aluka min fadlik, allahumma iAAsimnee minash-shaytanir-rajeem.)

22.translation: Mɔ̀gɔ bɛ kuma sɔrɔ cogo kelen na ni mu-aththin (sariya wele baga) bɛ kuma, fo tuma min na a bɛ fɔ: Hayya AAalas-salah (walima) hayya AAalal-falah 'na sariya, na seya' a nɔ na, mɔ̀gɔ ka fɔ: La hawla wala quwwata illa billah. 'Se tɛ yen, mɔgɔya tɛ yen fo Ala la.'

23.translation: Kɔfɛ laadamini kuma min mu-aththin bɛ wele, mɔ̀gɔ bɛ fɔ:'N fana bɛ shaidaa kɛ ko furu si tɛ yen Ala la, a kelen, a tɛ yen a la, ani ko Muhammadu ye a jòn ani a Kɛmɛ ye. N y'a ye Ala ye n ka Mara, Muhammadu ye n ka Kɛmɛ ani Silamɛya ye n ka diine.'
23.instruction: Kɔfɛ laadamini kuma min mu-aththin bɛ wele, mɔ̀gɔ bɛ fɔ:Wa-ana ashhadu an la ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh, radeetu billahi rabban wabimuhammadin rasoolan wabil-islami deena.

24.translation: 'Mɔ̀gɔ ka barika kɛ Nabiya (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) kan kɔfɛ a n'u mu.adhdhin weleli.'

25.translation: 'Ala ye, weleli dafalen nin Mara ani sariya min bɛɛ kɛ Mara, i ka al-waseelah ani al-fadeelah kɛ Muhammadu ma, i ka a ci ɲɔgɔn yɔrɔ kan min i dɛsɛ a ma. Tiɲɛ na, i tɛ i dɛsɛ tiɲɛ kɛ.'al-waseelah: Yɔrɔ alijanna la.al-fadeelah: Kunnafoni danbaga tɔ̀w san.ɲɔgɔn yɔrɔ: Yɔrɔ min kan danbagaw bɛɛ bɛ a fɔ̀li, ka jate kɛ ɲinini, ani k'a kɛnɛya kanjan tɔli walima ɲinini baara la.
25.instruction: Allahumma rabba hathihid-daAAwatit-tammah, wassalatil-qa-imah ati Muhammadan alwaseelata wal-fadeelah, wabAAath-hu maqaman mahmoodan allathee waAAadtah, innaka la tukhliful-meeAAad.

26.translation: Mɔ̀gɔ ka fana ka a yɛrɛ ɲini waati min bɛ athan ani iqamah cɛ k'a ɲini tuma o tuma tɛ ban.

5.translation: (Fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye Ala ye, A min kanu nin kɛ n na ani a y'a kɛ n na, se tɛ yen n fɛ, mɔgɔya tɛ yen n fɛ.)
5.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee kasanee hatha (aththawb) warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.)

6.translation: (Ala ye, fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye i ye, i y'a (lii lu, kanu) kɛ n na, n b'i ɲini a ɲɛ ani ɲɛ min a y'a kɛ a la, n bɛ kan kan i la a jugu ani jugu min a y'a kɛ a la.)
6.instruction: (Allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtaneeh, as-aluka min khayrihi wakhayri ma suniAAa lah, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharrihi washarri ma suniAAa lah.)

7.translation: (I ka a bɛɛ kɛ fo Ala (surunbaga) ka a yɛlɛ (tɔ̀).' A kɔrɔ: ɲini kɛra ɲɛnamaya jan la.)

8.translation: (Sɔli kura, ɲɛna ka ɲɛ, sa i ka shaheed.)(shaheed:Mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ sa a bɛ kuffar kɛra k'a Ala kuma kɛ surun walima ka Silamɛya kɛnɛyali. A tɛ fana kɔrɔ tɔ̀w Sunnah na i k'a mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ sa a bɛ kɛnɛyali kɛra a ɲɛnamaya, a duɲa walima a somɔgɔ̀w la; muso min bɛ sa a den bɔli la; min bɛ ji la sa…ani tɔ̀w.)

27.translation: (Ala ye, ɲɛnafɔli kɛ n ani n juruya cɛ cogo i y'a ɲɛnafɔli kɛ tilebila ani tilebila cɛ, Ala ye, saniya kɛ n juruya la cogo kanu jɛlen bɛ saniya tuntun la, Ala ye, wusu n juruya la raaxa, ji ani glaas fɛ.)
27.instruction: (Allahumma baAAid baynee wabayna khatayaya kama baAAadta baynal-mashriqi walmaghrib, allahumma naqqinee min khatayaya kama yunaqqath-thawbul-abyadu minad-danas, allahummagh-silnee min khatayaya biththalji walma/i walbarad.)

28.translation: (I ye jɔtɔ ye Ala ye, n b'i fɔ̀li. I tɔ̀gɔ̀ barika don, i yɔrɔ surun don, furu si tɛ yen i la.)
28.instruction: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdika watabarakas-muka wataAAala jadduka wala ilaha ghayruk.)

29.translation: (N ka n ɲɛ jɛ tiɲɛ la min bɛ sanjiw ani dugukolo ɲɛnafolo, n tɛ fɛn tɔ̀ kɛ Ala ta la mɔ̀gɔ minnu na. Tiɲɛ na n sariya, n saraka, n ɲɛnamaya ani n saa bɛɛ ye Ala ye, diinew Mara ye, a tɛ yen a la, o la n bɛ fɛɛrɛ, n ye Musulmani ye. Ala ye, i de ye Mara ye, furu si tɛ yen i la. I ye n ka Mara ye, n de ye i jòn ye, n y'a n hakili jugu, n ka n juruya dɔnni, o de ka n juruya bɛɛ yafa, kɔn mɔ̀gɔ si tɛ juruya yafa fo i. I ka n ɲɛjira kɛ nɲɛ ɲuman ma kɔn mɔ̀gɔ si tɛ se ka a ɲɛjira fo i, i ka n kɛnɛya kɛ nɲɛ juguman ma kɔn mɔ̀gɔ si tɛ se ka n kɛnɛya a la fo i. N nɛ, n b'i wele nangu, n bɛ nɛ ka i baara kɛ. Ɲɛ bɛɛ b'i bolow la, jugu tɛ bɔ i la. N bɛ ne i nafa la, n bɛ kɔ i fɛ. I barika don ani i surun don, n b'i yafa ɲini ani n b'i kan tubi.)(Ala tɛ jugu san san dan min tɛ ɲɛ walima nafa, xel walima hinɛ si kɔnɔ, a tɛ fana mɔ̀gɔ si gɛlɛya k'a juruya kɛ tɛ. Fɛn bɛ se ka ɲɛ a danya la n'i y'a ye cogo do la waati kelen na a bɛ jugu n'i y'a ye cogo tɔ̀ la. Ala y'a setani dan, a la, A b'a jònw ɲinini, o de k'a mɔ̀gɔ dɔw bɛ setani ɲɔgɔnna, a bɛ a ani a sira kɛra, u bɛ mɛɛn ani a mɔgɔw, mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀w bɛ setani ani a kelen, u b'a taama kɛ. O de k'a jugu bɛ a danbagaw la a nafa ani a xel la, a tɛ a baara walima a danya la.)
29.instruction: (Wajjahtu wajhiya lillathee fataras-samawati wal-arda haneefan wama ana minal-mushrikeen, inna salatee wanusukee wamahyaya wamamatee lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, la shareeka lahu wabithalika omirtu wa-ana minal-muslimeen. Allahumma antal-maliku la ilaha illa ant. anta rabbee wa-ana AAabduk, thalamtu nafsee waAAtaraftu bithanbee faghfir lee thunoobee jameeAAan innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.wahdinee li-ahsanil-akhlaqi la yahdee li-ahsaniha illa ant, wasrif AAannee sayyi-aha la yasrifu AAannee sayyi-aha illa ant, labbayka wasaAAdayk,walkhayru kulluhu biyadayk, washsharru laysa ilayk, ana bika wa-ilayk, tabarakta wataAAalayt, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)

30.translation: (Ala ye, Jibra-eel, Meeka-eel ani Israfeel (malaika baw) Mara, sanjiw ani dugukolo Dan, Muur ani ɲɛ Don. I de ye tansiri ye i jònw cɛ min na u y'a tiɲɛ. I ka n ɲɛjira tiɲɛ la i nɔ na, min na u y'a tiɲɛ, kɔn i bɛ mɔ̀gɔ min ɲɛjira sira tilennen ma i b'a feera.)
30.instruction: (Allahumma rabba jibra-eel, wameeka-eel, wa-israfeel fatiras-samawati walard, AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, anta tahkumu bayna AAibadika feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoon. ihdinee limakh-tulifa feehi minal-haqqi bi-ithnik, innaka tahdee man tasha-o ila siratin mustaqeem.)

31.translation: (Ala ka ca kosɛbɛ, Ala ka ca kosɛbɛ, Ala ka ca kosɛbɛ, fɔ̀li ca ye Ala ye, fɔ̀li ca ye Ala ye, fɔ̀li ca ye Ala ye, n b'Ala jɔtɔya fɔ sɔ̀gɔ̀ma ani wula.)(N bɛ kan kan Ala la setani la, a kaañ, a sɛrɛkili ani a folo la.)
31.instruction: (Allahu akbaru kabeera, Allahu akbaru kabeera, Allahu akbaru kabeera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, wasubhanal-lahi bukratan wa-aseela.)(aAAoothu billahi minash-shaytani min nafkhihi wanafthihi wahamzih.)

32.translation: (Ala ye, fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye i ye, i ye sanjiw ani dugukolo ani min bɛɛ u kɔnɔ Yeelenya ye. Fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye i ye, i ye sanjiw ani dugukolo ani min bɛɛ u kɔnɔ Taama-kɛ baga ye. Fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye i ye. I ye sanjiw ani dugukolo ani min bɛɛ u kɔnɔ Mara ye. Fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye i ye ani sanjiw ani dugukolo ani min bɛɛ u kɔnɔ mara. Fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye i ye, i ye sanjiw ani dugukolo Mansa ye, fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye i ye. I ye Tiɲɛ ye, i dɛsɛ tiɲɛ don, i Kuma tiɲɛ don, Don min na an bɛ'i ɲɔgɔn ye o tiɲɛ don, alijanna tiɲɛ don, tasuma tiɲɛ don, Nabiyaw tiɲɛ don, Muhammadu tiɲɛ don, Waati banba tiɲɛ don. Ala ye, n ka n di i ma, n bɛ kan kan i la, n b'i laadamini, n b'i kan tubi, n y'a tiɲɛ i kan, n y'a jate kɛ i fɛ. O de ka n yafa juruya minnu kɛra ani minnu bɛɛ kɛ, min n muura ani min n kɛra ɲɛ na. I ye Al-Muqaddim ani Al-Mu-akhkhir ye. Furu si tɛ yen i la, i de ye n ka Furu ye, furu si tɛ yen i la.)(Al-Muqaddim ani Al-Mu-akhkhir kɔrɔ: Ala bɛ mɔ̀gɔ min ɲɛjira ani ka a nafa kɛ a danbagaw la i b'a feera, ni a bɛ mɔ̀gɔ min yɔpɔ ani ka a to i b'a feera a xel kan. I k'a mɔ̀gɔ nafa kɛ danbaga tɔ̀w san, Nabiyaw nafa kɛ mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀w san, Muhammadu nafa kɛ Nabiyaw ani Kɛmɛw bɛɛ san…ani tɔ̀w.)
32.instruction: (Allahumma lakal-hamd anta noorus-samawati wal-ardi waman feehin, walakal-hamd, anta qayyimus-samawati walardi waman feehin, [walakal-hamd, anta rabbus-samawati walardi waman feehin], [walakal-hamd, laka mulkus-samawati walardi waman feehin] [walakal-hamd, anta malikus-samawati walard] [walakal-hamd] [antal-haq, wawaAAdukal-haq, waqawlukal-haq, waliqa-okal-haq, waljannatu haq wannaru haq, wannabiyyoona haq, wa Muhammadun  haq, wassaAAatu haq] [allahumma laka aslamt, waAAalayka tawakkalt, wabika amant, wa-ilayka anabt, wabika khasamt, wa-ilayka hakamt, faghfir lee ma qaddamt, wama akhkhart, wama asrart, wama aAAlant] [antal-muqaddim, wa-antal-mu-akhkhir, la ilaha illa ant] [anta ilahee la ilaha illa ant .)

33.translation: (N ka Mara ye jɔtɔ ye, a Kuntigi.'(saba kɔ))

34.translation: (I ye jɔtɔ ye Ala ye, an ka Mara, n b'i fɔ̀li. Ala ye, i ka n yafa.)

35.translation: (Jɔtɔ ani Pêl (A ye), malaikaw Mara ani Rooh (lii lu, Jibra-eel) Mara.)

36.translation: (Ala ye, n ka ruku i ma, n b'i laadamini, n ka n di i ma. N mɛn, n ye, n hakili, n kolow, n fɛɛnɛw ani min n tɔngɔw ta, o bɛɛ bɛ mɔgɔya i ɲɛ na.)
36.instruction: (Allahumma laka rakaAAt, wabika amant, walaka aslamt, khashaAAa laka samAAee, wabasaree, wamukhkhee, waAAathmee, waAAasabee, wamas-taqalla bihi qadamee.)

37.translation: (A ye jɔtɔ ye, se bɛɛ, mara, bonya ani fɛɛrɛ Mara.)

38.translation: (Ala ka mɔ̀gɔ min b'a fɔ̀li o nangu.)(Nin ɲini kɛra n'i wulira.)

39.translation: (An ka Mara, fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye i ye, fɔ̀li ca ɲuman barika.)
39.instruction: (Rabbana walakal-hamdu hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh.)

40.translation: (Sanjiw ani dugukolo ani min bɛɛ u cɛ, o bɛɛ ca i fɔ̀li la, min bɛɛ i b'a feera o ca i fɔ̀li la. A Fɔ̀li ani Bonya Mara, kuma tiɲɛnta min jòn fɔra (i kan) an bɛɛ ye i jònw ye. Ala ye, mɔ̀gɔ si tɛ se ka min i y'a nafa kɛ a kɛnɛya, mɔ̀gɔ si tɛ se ka min i y'a kɛnɛya a nafa kɛ, duɲa walima bonya si tɛ se ka mɔ̀gɔ si nafa kɛ, kɔn i fɛ la duɲa ani bonya bɛɛ bɛ bɔ.)
40.instruction: (Mil-as-samawati wamil-al-ard, wama baynahuma, wamil/a ma shi/ta min shay-in baAAd, ahlath-thana-i walmajd, ahaqqu ma qalal-AAabd, wakulluna laka AAabd. Allahumma la maniAAa lima aAAtayt, wala muAAtiya lima manaAAt, wala yanfaAAu thal-jaddi minkal-jad.)

41.translation: (N ka Mara ye jɔtɔ ye, a Surunbaga.'(saba kɔ))

42.translation: (I ye jɔtɔ ye Ala ye, an ka Mara, n b'i fɔ̀li. Ala ye, i ka n yafa.)

43.translation: (Jɔtɔ ani Pêl (A ye), malaikaw Mara ani Rooh (lii lu, Jibra-eel) Mara.)

44.translation: (Ala ye, n ka sujudu i ma, n b'i laadamini, n ka n di i ma. N ɲɛ y'a sujudu a min y'a dan ani k'a lada, k'a mɛn ani a ye fɛɛrɛw bɔ. Ala barika don, danbagaw ɲuman.)
44.instruction: (Allahumma laka sajadt, wabika amant, walaka aslamt, sajada wajhee lillathee khalaqahu wasawwarahu washaqqa samAAahu wabasarahu, tabarakal-lahu ahsanul-khaliqeen.)

45.translation: (A ye jɔtɔ ye, se bɛɛ, mara, bonya ani fɛɛrɛ Mara.)

46.translation: (Ala ye, i ka n juruya bɛɛ yafa, u dɔɔniya ani u bonya, u fɔlɔ ani u banba, ani u ɲɛ ani u muura.)
46.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lee thanbee kullah, diqqahu wajillah, wa-awwalahu wa-akhirah, wa- AAalaniyyatahu wa-sirrah.)

47.translation: (Ala ye, n bɛ kan kan i nafa la i ɲɔgɔnna la, i yafa la i gɛlɛya la, n bɛ kan kan i la i la. N tɛ se k'i fɔ̀li jate, i ye cogo i y'i yɛrɛ fɔ̀li.)
47.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik, wa-bimuAAafatika min AAuqoobatik, wa-aAAoothu bika mink, la ohsee thana-an AAalayk, anta kama athnayta AAala nafsik.)

48.translation: (N ka Mara i ka n yafa, N ka Mara i ka n yafa.)

49.translation: (Ala ye, i ka n yafa, i ka n hinɛ, i ka n ɲɛjira, i ka n ɲɛ, i ka n kɛnɛya, i ka n duɲa kɛ ani ka n yɔrɔ yɛrɛ.)
49.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, wajburnee, waAAafinee, warzuqnee warfaAAnee.)

50.translation: (N ɲɛ y'a sujudu a min y'a dan ani k'a mɛn ani a ye fɛɛrɛw bɔ a se ani a mɔgɔya fɛ.<< O de k'a Ala barika don, danbagaw ɲuman.)
50.instruction: (Sajada wajhee lillathee khalaqahu washaqqa samAAahu wabasarahu bihawlihi waquwwatih  { tabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeen}.)

51.translation: (Ala ye, sɛbɛ n ma sara nin (sujudu) la, i ka juruya bɔ n na. Kɛnɛyali kɛ a ma n ma ani nangu a n ma cogo i y'a nangu i jòn Dawood ma.)
51.instruction: (Allahummak-tub lee biha  AAindaka ajra, wadaAA  AAannee biha wizra, wajAAalha lee AAindaka thukhra, wataqabbalha minnee kama taqabbaltaha min AAabdika Dawood.)

52.translation: (At-tahiyyat ye Ala ye. Baara bɛɛ ani baara ɲuman bɛɛ ye a ye. Hɛɛrɛ ani Ala hinɛ ani barika kɛ i kan a Nabiya. Hɛɛrɛ kɛ an kan ani Ala jòn ɲumanw bɛɛ kan. N bɛ shaidaa kɛ ko furu si tɛ yen Ala la, n bɛ shaidaa kɛ ko Muhammadu ye a jòn ani a Kɛmɛ ye.)(At-tahiyyat: kuma bɛɛ minnu b'Ala bonya fɔ. A ɲɛnamaya kɔrɔba, a mat ani a mara.)
52.instruction: (Attahiyyatu lillahi wassalawatu wattayyibat, assalamu AAalayka ayyuhan-nabiyyu warahmatul-lahi wabarakatuh, assalamu AAalayna waAAala AAibadil-lahis-saliheen. Ash-hadu an la ilaha illal-lah, wa-ashhadu anna Muhammadan AAabduhu warasooluh.)

53.translation: (Ala ye, i ka barika kɛ Muhammadu kan ani Muhammadu mɔgɔw kan, cogo i y'a barika kɛ Ibraahima kan ani Ibraahima mɔgɔw kan. Tiɲɛ na, i ca fɔ̀li ani bonya la. Ala ye, i ka barika kɛ Muhammadu kan ani Muhammadu somɔgɔ̀w kan, cogo i y'a barika kɛ Ibraahima kan ani Ibraahima somɔgɔ̀w kan. Tiɲɛ na, i ca fɔ̀li ani bonya la.)(barika kɛ: a fɔ̀li ani k'a yɛrɛ kunnafoni surun ani ɲuman kɔnɔ: malaikaw minnu kɛrɛfɛ Ala)(（al）sɛbɛlen don a kɔrɔ baa la: dɔnnikɛla dɔw b'a fɛ ko a kɔrɔ ɲɛfɛɛnɛ don, a kɔrɔ: a mɔgɔw a somɔgɔ̀w la.)
53.instruction: (Allahumma salli AAala Muhammad, wa-AAala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta AAala Ibraheema wa-AAala ali Ibraheem, innaka Hameedun Majeed, allahumma barik AAala  Muhammad, wa-AAala ali Muhammad, kama barakta AAala Ibraheema wa-AAala ali Ibraheem, innaka Hameedun Majeed.)

54.translation: (Ala ye, i ka barika kɛ Muhammadu kan ani Muhammadu musow ani a denw kan, cogo i y'a barika kɛ Ibraahima somɔgɔ̀w kan, i ka barika kɛ Muhammadu kan ani a musow ani a denw kan, cogo i y'a barika kɛ Ibraahima somɔgɔ̀w kan. Tiɲɛ na, i ca fɔ̀li ani bonya la.)
54.instruction: (Allahumma salli AAala Muhammad wa-AAala azwajihi wathurriyyatihi kama sallayta AAala ali Ibraheem, wabarik AAala Muhammad, wa-AAala azwajihi wathurriyyatih, kama barakta AAala ali Ibraheem. innaka Hameedun Majeed.)

55.translation: (Ala ye, n bɛ kan kan i la saama gɛlɛya la, tasuma gɛlɛya la, ɲɛnamaya ani saa ɲinini ani gɛlɛya la ani Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal jugu gɛlɛya la.)(Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal: waati banba mɔ̀gɔ baw ani ɲinini baw minnu bɛ mɔ̀gɔ̀w kan, Nabiya kelen-kelen bɛɛ y'a kuma kan. Mɔ̀gɔ caman bɛ a taama kɛ. A bɛ bɔ Asbahan, Iran waati min na Musulmaniw bɛ Constantinople ta. A bɛ se kɛrɛnkɛrɛnni kɛ, a bɛ tiɲɛ kɛ nkalon ani a kɔfɛ. A b'i yɛrɛ fɔ a ye tiɲɛ baga ye, o kɔfɛ a b'i yɛrɛ fɔ a ye nabiya ye, a ban na a b'i yɛrɛ fɔ a ye Ala ye. A fɛɛrɛw la, a bɛ finya a nyɛ tilennen la, min ye dɛsɛ tiɲɛ ye min b'a ñàqqu fɔ a ye Ala ye, k'a ye maaɲa dɔ ye. Kuma Kafir sɛbɛlen bɛ a nyɛw cɛ, laadamini baga kelen-kelen bɛɛ, kalan baga walima kalan tɛ, b'a dɔn.)(Mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ soorat Al-Kahf aya tan fɔlɔw don a bɛ kan kan Dajjal la.)(Mɔ̀gɔ ka fana ka kan kan Ala la Dajjal gɛlɛya la tashahhud banba kɔ sariya la.(Ye ɲini #55 ani #56 ye))
55.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, wamin AAathabi jahannam, wamin fitnatil-mahya walmamat, wamin shari fitnatil-maseehid-dajjal.)

56.translation: (Ala ye, n bɛ kan kan i la saama gɛlɛya la, n bɛ kan kan i la Al-Maseeh Ad-Dajjal ɲinini ani ɲinini la, n bɛ kan kan i la ɲɛnamaya ani saa ɲinini ani gɛlɛya la. Ala ye, n bɛ kan kan i la juruya ani cɛru la.)
56.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, wa-aAAoothu bika min fitnatil-maseehid-dajjal, wa-aAAoothu bika min fitnatil-mahya walmamat. Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-ma/thami walmaghram.)

57.translation: (Ala ye, n y'a n hakili jugu ca, mɔ̀gɔ si tɛ juruya yafa fo i, o de ka n yafa yafa min b'i fɛ ani ka n hinɛ. Tiɲɛ na, i de ye a Yafa baa ye, a Hinɛ baa ye.)(I fɛ: lii lu, i hinɛ kɔnɔ saniya n'a sara tɛ, yafa min b'i jox baa kan.)
57.instruction: (Allahumma innee thalamtu nafsee thulman katheeran wala yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant, faghfir lee maghfiratan min AAindik warhamnee, innaka antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem.)

58.translation: (Ala ye, i ka n yafa juruya minnu kɛra ani minnu bɛɛ kɛ, min n muura ani min n kɛra ɲɛ na, ani min n tɛmɛna kan ani minnu i don kosɛbɛ n tɛ. I ye Al-Muqaddim ani Al-Mu-akhkhir ye. Furu si tɛ yen i la.)(Al-Muqaddim ani Al-Mu-akhkhir kɔrɔ: Ala bɛ mɔ̀gɔ min ɲɛjira ani ka a nafa kɛ a danbagaw la i b'a feera, ni a bɛ mɔ̀gɔ min yɔpɔ ani ka a to i b'a feera a xel kan. I k'a mɔ̀gɔ nafa kɛ danbaga tɔ̀w san, Nabiyaw nafa kɛ mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀w san, Muhammadu nafa kɛ Nabiyaw ani Kɛmɛw bɛɛ san…ani tɔ̀w.)
58.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lee ma qaddamtu,  wama akhkhart, wama asrartu wama aAAlant, wama asraftt, wama anta aAAlamu bihi minnee, antal-muqaddimu wa-antal-mu-akhkhiru la ilaha illa ant.)

59.translation: (Ala ye, dɛmɛ kɛ n ma ka i kuma kɛ, ka i ni ce, ani ka i baara kɛ cogo ɲuman na.)
59.instruction: (Allahumma aAAinnee AAala thikrik, washukrik, wahusni AAibadatik.)

60.translation: (Ala ye, n bɛ kan kan i la cɛru ani cɛri la, n bɛ kan kan i la k'a n kɔ ɲɛnamaya jugu ma "lii lu, kɔrɔbali, doole tɛ, se tɛ ani siran kɔnɔ", n bɛ kan kan i la duniya ɲinini ani gɛlɛya ani saama gɛlɛya la.)
60.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-bukhl, wa-aAAoothu bika minal-jubn, wa-aAAoothu bika min an oradda ila arthalil- AAumur, wa-aAAoothu bika min fitnatid-dunya waAAathabil-qabr.)

61.translation: (Ala ye, n b'i ɲini ka n alijanna kɛ, n bɛ kan kan i la tasuma la.)

62.translation: (Ala ye, i muur dɔnniya ani i se danbagaw kan, kɛ n ɲɛnamaya kɛ waati i dɔn ko ɲɛnamaya o ye ɲɛ ye n ma, n ta n'i dɔn ko saa ye ɲɛ ye n ma. Ala ye, kɛ n i siran baga ye muur walima ɲɛ na, n b'i ɲini ka n tiɲɛ kuma kɛ nafa ani dimi waatiw la. N b'i ɲini ka n cɛgɛn kɛ duɲa ani hɔgɔya waatiw la, n b'i ɲini nafa ani nɛnɛ min bɛɛ tɛ ban. N b'i ɲini ka n nafa kɛ min i cira ani ɲɛnamaya nɔɔsɔ sa kɔfɛ. N b'i ɲini i ɲɛ ye diya ani i ɲɔgɔn ye ɲini cogo min tɛ gɛlɛya kɛ min bɛ jugu kɛ walima ɲinini min bɛ sɛgɛn. Ala ye, lada kɛ an ma laadamini lada fɛ, k'an mɔ̀gɔ minnu bɛ ɲɛjira ani ɲɛjiralen ye.)
62.instruction: (Allahumma biAAilmikal-ghayb, waqudratika AAalal-khalq, ahyinee ma AAalimtal-hayata khayran lee watawaffanee itha AAalimtal-wafata khayran lee, allahumma innee as-aluka khashyataka fil-ghaybi washshahadah, wa-as-aluka kalimatal-haqqi fir-rida walghadab, wa-as-alukal-qasda fil-ghina walfaqr, wa-as-aluka naAAeeman la yanfad, wa-as-aluka qurrata AAaynin la tanqatiAA, wa-as-alukar-rida baAAdal-qada/, wa-as-aluka bardal-AAayshi baAAdal-mawt, wa-as-aluka laththatan-nathari ila wajhik, washshawqa ila liqa-ik fee ghayri darraa mudirrah, wala fitnatin mudillah, allahumma zayyinna bizeenatil-eeman wajAAalna hudatan muhtadeen.)

63.translation: (Ala ye, n b'i ɲini a Ala, i de ye a Kelen, a Kelen, AS-Samad, A min m'a den don, a m'a den don, a tɛ yen a la, i ka n juruyaw yafa kɔn tiɲɛ na i de ye a Yafa baa ye, a Hinɛ baa ye.)(AS-Samad: Mara min tɛ fɛn si soxla, fɛɛrɛ dafalenw Mara, danbagaw bɛɛ bɛ a kan u soxla bɛɛ la.)
63.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka ya Allah bi-annakal-wahidul-ahadus-samad, allathee lam yalid walam yoolad, walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad, an taghfira lee thunoobee innaka antal-Ghafoorur-Raheem.)

64.translation: (Ala ye, n b'i ɲini k'a fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye i ye, furu si tɛ yen i la, i kelen, i tɛ yen i la. I ye Nafa baga ye. A sanjiw ani dugukolo Dan, a Bonya ani Shan Mara, a ɲɛnamaya baga, a Tiɲɛ dabagaw bɛɛ Taama-kɛ baga, tiɲɛ na n b'i ɲini alijanna, n bɛ kan kan i la tasuma la.)
64.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka bianna lakal-hamd, la ilaha illa ant wahdaka la shareeka lak, almannan, ya badeeAAas-samawati wal-ard, ya thal-jalali wal-ikram, ya hayyu ya qayyoom, innee as-alukal-jannah, wa-aAAoothu bika minan-nar.)

65.translation: (Ala ye, n b'i ɲini, k'a n bɛ shaidaa kɛ ko i ye Ala ye, furu si tɛ yen i la, a Kelen, AS-Samad A min m'a den don, a m'a den don, a tɛ yen a la.)(AS-Samad: Mara min tɛ fɛn si soxla, fɛɛrɛ dafalenw Mara, danbagaw bɛɛ bɛ a kan u soxla bɛɛ la.)
65.instruction: (Allahumma inne as-aluka biannee ashhadu annaka antal-lah, la ilaha illa ant, al-ahadus-samad, allathee lam yalid walam yoolad walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad.)

66.translation: (N b'Ala yafa ɲini.(saba kɔ) (Ala ye, i ye As-Salam ye, hɛɛrɛ bɛɛ b'i fɛ, i barika don, a Bonya ani Shan Mara.) (AS-Salam: A min jege don ñɔ̀gɔn ani ñɔ̀gɔn bɛɛ la.))
66.instruction: (Astaghfirul-lah (saba kɔ) (Allahumma antas-salam waminkas-salam, tabarakta ya thal-jalali wal-ikram.))

67.translation: (Furu si tɛ yen Ala la, a kelen, a tɛ yen a la, mara ani fɔ̀li bɛɛ t'a ye, a bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la. Ala ye, mɔ̀gɔ si tɛ se ka min i y'a nafa kɛ a kɛnɛya, mɔ̀gɔ si tɛ se ka min i y'a kɛnɛya a nafa kɛ, duɲa walima bonya si tɛ se ka mɔ̀gɔ si nafa kɛ, kɔn i fɛ la duɲa ani bonya bɛɛ bɛ bɔ.)
67.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, allahumma la maniAAa lima aAAtayt, wala muAAtiya lima manaAAt, wala yanfaAAu thal-jaddi minkal-jad.)

68.translation: (Furu si tɛ yen Ala la, a kelen, a tɛ yen a la, mara ani fɔ̀li bɛɛ t'a ye, a bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la. Se tɛ yen, mɔgɔya tɛ yen fo Ala la, furu si tɛ yen Ala la, an tɛ furu tɔ̀ baara kɛ fo a. Nafa, san ani fɔ̀li bonya bɛɛ ye a ye. Furu si tɛ yen Ala la, an bɛ tiɲɛ ani dɛsɛ kɛ a la li kafiriw b'a jugu.)
68.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer. la hawla wala quwwata illa billah, la ilaha illal-lah, wala naAAbudu illa iyyah, lahun-niAAmatu walahul-fadl walahuth-thana-ol- hasan, la ilaha illal-lah mukhliseena lahud-deen walaw karihal-kafiroon.)

69.translation: (Ala ye jɔtɔ ye, fɔ̀li bɛɛ ye Ala ye, Ala ka ca kosɛbɛ.(biɲi saba ni saba kɔ) (Furu si tɛ yen Ala la, a kelen, a tɛ yen a la, mara ani fɔ̀li bɛɛ t'a ye, a bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la.))
69.instruction: (Subhanal-lah walhamdu lillah, wallahu akbar (biɲi saba ni saba kɔ). (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.))

70.translation: Sura saba ninnu ka kɛ kelen Zuhr, 'Asr ani 'Ishaa sariya kɔ ani saba kɔ Fajr ani Maghrib sariya kɔ.[Soorah al-Ikhlaas (112)] [Soorah al-Falaq (113)] [Soorah an-Naas (114)]

71.translation: A tɛ fana Sunnah na ka Aayat ul-Kursee kɛ sariya o sariya kɔ:[Soorah al-Baqarah, Aayah 255]

72.translation: (Furu si tɛ yen Ala la, a kelen, a tɛ yen a la, mara ani fɔ̀li bɛɛ t'a ye, A bɛ ɲɛnamaya kɛ ani ka saa kɛ, a bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ la.(tan kɔ maghrib ani fajr sariya kɔ))
72.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, yuhyee wayumeet, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.(tan kɔ maghrib ani fajr sariya kɔ))

73.translation: (Ala ye, n b'i ɲini dɔnniya min bɛ nafa ani duɲa min diɲɛ ani baara min bɛ nangu.)(Kuma nin kɛra salam kɔ fajr sariya la)
73.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.(salam kɔ fajr sariya la))

74.translation: (Jabir Ibn AAabdullah ma, a fɔ: 'Nabiyara b'an kalan ka ɲɛjirali ɲini an ko bɛɛ la, cogo a b'an kalan sura Kurana la. A bɛ fɔ: 'N'i dɔ b'i ko bɛɛ la, a ka sariya fila kɛ (fila rakAAah nafilah) o kɔfɛ a ka ɲini kɛ:'Ala ye, n b'i kuma ɲini i dɔnniya la, i se la n b'i se ɲini, n b'i ɲini i nafa baa fɛ, kɔn tiɲɛ na i bɛ se, n tɛ se, tiɲɛ na i don, n tɛ don, i ye Muur Don ye. Ala ye, n'i dɔn ko ko nin ye ɲɛ ye n ma n diine, n ɲɛnamaya ani n banba kan, kɛ a cira ani a nɔɔsɔ n ma, i ka a barika n na, n'i dɔn ko ko nin ye jugu ye n ma n diine, n ɲɛnamaya ani n banba kan, bɔ a n na ani bɔ n a na, kɛ ɲɛ min bɛ yen o yen cira n ma ani kɛ n nafa kɛ a la.)(Mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ ɲɛjirali ɲini a Dan fɛ ani ka a kelenbagaw kuma kɛ, o kɔfɛ a to a cira kan, a tɛ nɔgɔya, kɔn Ala y'a fɔ:…kuma kɛ u fɛ ko la. N'i y'a cira ta, i ka i kan kan Ala la…)
74.instruction: (Jabir Ibn AAabdullah ma, a fɔ: 'Nabiyara b'an kalan ka ɲɛjirali ɲini an ko bɛɛ la, cogo a b'an kalan sura Kurana la. A bɛ fɔ: ' If any of you intends to undertake a matter then let him pray two supererogatory units (two rakAAah nafilah) of prayer and after which he should supplicate:Allahumma innee astakheeruka biAAilmik, wa-astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa-as-aluka min fadlikal-AAatheem, fa-innaka taqdiru wala aqdir, wataAAlamu wala aAAlam ,wa-anta AAallamul ghuyoob, allahumma in kunta taAAlamu anna hathal-amr (say your need) khayrun lee fee deenee wamaAAashee waAAaqibati amree faqdurhu lee, wayassirhu lee, thumma barik lee feeh, wa-in kunta taAAlamu anna hathal-amr sharrun lee fee deenee wamaAAashee waAAaqibati amree fasrifhu AAannee wasrifnee AAanh, waqdur liyal-khayra haythu kan, thumma ardinee bih.)(One who seeks guidance from his Creator and consults his fellow believers and then remains firm in his resolve does not regret, for Allah has said:washawirhum fee al-amri fa-itha AAazamta fatawakkal AAala Allah)(chapter 3 verse 159)

112.translation: (Furu si tɛ yen Ala la, a Kelen, AL-Qahhaar. Sanjiw ani dugukolo ani min bɛɛ u cɛ Mara, a Se baa, a Yafa baa.)(AL-Qahhaar: A min y'a danbagaw bɛɛ yɛrɛ, danbagaw bɛɛ bɛ a kan. Taama bɛɛ bɛ a nafa la.)
112.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahul-wahidul-qahhar, rabbus-samawati wama baynahuma, alAAazeezul-ghaffar.)

113.translation: (N bɛ kan kan Ala kuma dafalenw la a dimi ani a gɛlɛya la, a jònw jugu la, ani setaniw folo ani u bɔli la.)
113.instruction: (aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat min ghadabih,waAAiqabih, washarri AAibadih, wamin hamazatish-shayateen, wa-an yahduroon.)

114.translation: [((Tu i cɛmana saba kɔ)(Tu: tu min bɛ mɔgɔ fɛ ni ji dɔɔni)) - (Bɛ kan kan Ala la setani ani min i ye jugu la (saba kɔ)) - (Kana a kuma mɔ̀gɔ si ma) - (Yɛlɛ ani sunɔgɔ fɛn tɔ̀ kan min i y'a kan sunɔgɔ fɔlɔ.) - (Wuli ani sariya n'i b'a feera.) ]

116.translation: (Ala ye, ɲɛjira kɛ n ma ani mɔ̀gɔ minnu i ɲɛjira, yafa kɛ n ma ani mɔ̀gɔ minnu i yafa, kɛ n bolodaa ye ani mɔ̀gɔ minnu i ye u bolodaa ye, barika kɛ n ma min i y'a nafa kɛ. Kɛnɛyali kɛ n ma jugu la min i cira kɔn tiɲɛ na i bɛ cira, mɔ̀gɔ si tɛ cira i kan. Tiɲɛ na, mɔ̀gɔ min i bɛ bolodaa ye a tɛ wàcce, mɔ̀gɔ min i bɛ mɛɛn ye a tɛ shan. An ka Mara, i barika don ani i surun don.)(Jugu min i cira: Ala tɛ jugu san san dan min tɛ ɲɛ walima nafa, xel walima hinɛ si kɔnɔ, a tɛ fana mɔ̀gɔ si gɛlɛya k'a juruya kɛ tɛ. Fɛn bɛ se ka ɲɛ a danya la n'i y'a ye cogo do la waati kelen na a bɛ jugu n'i y'a ye cogo tɔ̀ la. Ala y'a setani dan, a la, A b'a jònw ɲinini, o de k'a mɔ̀gɔ dɔw bɛ setani ɲɔgɔnna, a bɛ a ani a sira kɛra, u bɛ mɛɛn ani a mɔgɔw, mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀w bɛ setani ani a kelen, u b'a taama kɛ. O de k'a jugu bɛ a danbagaw la a nafa ani a xel la, a tɛ a baara walima a danya la.)
116.instruction: (Allahummah-dinee feeman hadayt, waAAafinee feeman AAafayt, watawallanee feeman tawallayt, wabarik lee feema aAAtayt, waqinee sharra ma qadayt, fa-innaka taqdee wala yuqda AAalayk, innahu la yathillu man walayt, [wala yaAAizzu man AAadayt], tabarakta rabbana wataAAalayt.)

117.translation: (Ala ye, n bɛ kan kan i nafa la i ɲɔgɔnna la, i yafa la i gɛlɛya la, n bɛ kan kan i la i la. N tɛ se k'i fɔ̀li jate. I ye cogo i y'i yɛrɛ fɔ̀li.)
117.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu biridaka min sakhatik, wabimuAAafatika min AAuqoobatik, wa-aAAoothu bika mink, la ohsee thana-an AAalayk, anta kama athnayta AAala nafsik.)

118.translation: (Ala ye, i de la an bɛ baara kɛ, i ma an bɛ sariya ani sujudu, i fɛ an bɛ gaaw ani i de la an bɛ baara kɛ. An b'i hinɛ jɔni ani an b'i gɛlɛya siran, tiɲɛ na i gɛlɛya bɛ kafiriw kan. Ala ye, an b'i dɛmɛ ɲini ani an b'i yafa ɲini, an b'i fɔ̀li ɲɛ bɛɛ la, an t'i laadamini tɛ. An b'i laadamini ani an b'i kan di, an bɛ ban ani ban mɔ̀gɔ minnu t'i laadamini.)
118.instruction: (Allahumma iyyaka naAAbud, walaka nusallee wanasjud, wa-ilayka nasAAa wanahfid, narjoo rahmatak, wanakhsha AAathabak, inna AAathabaka bilkafireena mulhaq. Allahumma inna nastaAAeenuk, wanastaghfiruk, wanuthnee AAalaykal- khayr, wala nakfuruk, wanu/minu bik, wanakhdaAAu lak wanakhlaAAu man yakfuruk.)

119.translation: (Mansa, a Pêl baga ye jɔtɔ ye.(saba kɔ) sabanan kɔ a y'a kan yɛrɛ, a janya ani a y'a kɛ: (malaikaw Mara ani Rooh (lii lu, Jibra-eel) Mara.))
119.instruction: (Subhanal-malikil-quddoos.(saba kɔ).sabanan kɔ a y'a kan yɛrɛ, a janya ani a y'a kɛ: (Rabbil-mala-ikati warrooh.))

120.translation: (Ala ye, n ye i jòn ye, i jòn den, i muso jòn den, n kunfɛn b'i bolo la (lii lu, i bɛ se bɛɛ n kan), i fɛɛrɛ n kan bɛ baara kɛ waati bɛɛ ani i cira n kan yem don. N b'i ɲini tɔ̀gɔ̀ o tɔ̀gɔ̀ min ye i ta, min i y'i yɛrɛ tɔ̀gɔ̀, walima yira i Kitabu la, walima kalan i danbaga si ma, walima kɛnɛyali i muur dɔnniya la i fɛ, i ka Kurana kɛ n hakili ɲɛnamaya ani n kɔ yeelenya, n son bɔli ani n gɛlɛya bɔli.)
120.instruction: (Allahumma innee AAabduk, ibnu AAabdik, ibnu amatik, nasiyatee biyadik, madin fiyya hukmuk, AAadlun fiyya qada-ok, as-aluka bikulli ismin huwa lak, sammayta bihi nafsak, aw anzaltahu fee kitabik, aw AAallamtahu ahadan min khalqik awis-ta/tharta bihi fee AAilmil-ghaybi AAindak, an tajAAalal-Qurana rabeeAAa qalbee, wanoora sadree, wajalaa huznee wathahaba hammee.)

121.translation: (Ala ye, n bɛ kan kan i la gɛlɛya ani son la, doole tɛ ani kaɲi la, cɛru ani cɛri la, cɛru giran ani mɔ̀gɔw yɛrɛ n kan la.)
121.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, walAAajzi walkasali walbukhli waljubn, wadalAAid-dayni waghalabatir-rijal.)

122.translation: (Furu si tɛ yen Ala la a Muur baa. Furu si tɛ yen Ala la, kursi baa Mara ye. Furu si tɛ yen Ala la, sanjiw Mara, dugukolo Mara ani kursi noyaba Mara ye.)
122.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lahul-AAatheemul-haleem, la ilaha illal-lahu rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem, la ilaha illal-lahu  rabbus-samawati warabbul-ardi warabbul-AAarshil-kareem.)

123.translation: (Ala ye, i hinɛ de la n bɛ jɔni, o de kana n to n yɛrɛ na fo nyɛ bɛɛ fɛ, ɲɛjira kɛ n ko bɛɛ la. Furu si tɛ yen i la.)
123.instruction: (Allahumma rahmataka arjoo fala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn, wa-aslih lee sha/nee kullah, la ilaha illa ant.)

124.translation: (Furu si tɛ yen i la. I ye jɔtɔ ye, tiɲɛ na n ye jugu-kɛ bagaw la.)
124.instruction: (La ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu minath-thalimeen.)

125.translation: (Ala, Ala de ye n ka Mara ye, n tɛ fɛn si kɛ a ta la.)

126.translation: (Ala ye, an b'i d'a ɲɛ na u ɲɛ na, an bɛ kan kan i la u jugu la.)
126.instruction: (Allahumma inna najAAaluka fee nuhoorihim wanaAAoothu bika min shuroorihim.)

127.translation: (Ala ye, i ye n dɛmɛ baga ye, i ye n dɛmɛ baga ye, i la n bɛ taama, i la n bɛ hajj, i la n bɛ kɛra.)
127.instruction: (Allahumma anta AAadudee, wa-anta naseeree, bika ajoolu wabika asoolu wabika oqatil)

128.translation: (Ala ka ca an ma, cogo ɲuman la jɛm baga (a ye).)

129.translation: Ala ye, sanji jɛkuruw Mara, kursi baa Mara, kɛ n dɛmɛ ye [mɔ̀gɔ min tɔ̀gɔ̀] ani a dɛmɛbagaw i danbagaw la, k'u dɔ k'a n jugu walima k'a n toon. I bolodaa bonya don, i fɔ̀li shan don. Furu si tɛ yen i la.
129.instruction: Allaahumma rabbas-samaawaatis-sab'i, wa Rabbal-'Arshil-'Adheem, Kun lee jaaran min (fii i ka mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀gɔ̀ fɔ) wa 'ahzabihi min khalaa'iqika, 'an yafruta 'alayya 'ahadun minhum 'aw yatghaa,'Azza jaaruka, wa jalla thanaa'uka, wa laa 'ilaaha 'illaa 'Anta.

130.translation: Ala ka ca kosɛbɛ, a Se baa a danbagaw bɛɛ kan. A Se baa min n bɛ siran ani ragal kan. N bɛ kan kan Ala la, min furu si tɛ yen a la. A de ye A min bɛ sanji jɛkuruw ta k'u bɛn dugukolo kan k'a fɛɛrɛ tɛ. [N bɛ kan kan i la Ala] i jòn jugu la [mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀gɔ̀], a dɛmɛbagaw, a mɔgɔw ani a bolodaaw jin ani mɔ̀gɔ la. Ala ye, kɛ n aar ye u jugu la. I fɔ̀li shan don, i bolodaa bonya don. I Tɔ̀gɔ̀ barika don, furu tiɲɛ si tɛ yen i la. (Kɛ a kɔ saba kɔ Arabukan na)
130.instruction: Allaahu Akbar, Allaahu 'a'azzu min khalqihi jamee'an, Allaahu 'a'azzu mimmaa 'akhaafu wa 'ahdharu, 'a'oothu billaahil-lathee laa ilaaha illaa huwa, almumsikis-samaawaatis-sab'i 'an yaqa'na 'alaal-'ardhi 'illaa bi'ithnihi, min sharri 'abdika (mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀gɔ̀) wa junoodihi wa 'atbaa'ihi wa ashyaa'ihi minal-jinni wal'insi, Allaahumma kun lee jaaran min sharrihim, Jalla thanaa'uka wa 'azza aaruka, wa tabaarakasmuka, wa laa ilaaha ghayruka.

131.translation: (Ala ye, Kitabu Yiridala, gaaw ci jate, sàcc bolokoloba. Ala ye, sàcc u ani tirisigi u.)

132.translation: (Ala ye, kɛnɛyali kɛ n ma u ma min i b'a feera.)

133.instruction: (Fɔ:) n bɛ kan kan Ala la. (O kɔfɛ i ka dabila min i b'a la diisoo.)

134.translation: (A ka fɔ: (N y'a laadamini Ala ani a Kɛmɛ la.))

135.translation: (A ka fana aya ninnu kɛ: (A de ye a Fɔlɔ ani a Banba ye, Aththaahir ani Al-Baatin, a don na fɛn bɛɛ lool.)(Aththaahir: o b'a fɛɛrɛw bonya ani danbaga kelen-kelen bɛɛ dɔɔniya a bonya ani a surun ɲɛ na, k'a t'a danbagaw bɛɛ san a mɛnni ani a fɛɛrɛw la.)(Al-Baatin: o b'a donya ani a dɔnniya muur bɛɛ la, min bɛ hakiliw na ani fɛn ɲagaminɛw, ni o b'a kɛrɛfɛ ani a kɛrɛfɛ bɛɛ la cogo min b'a bonya kan.))
135.instruction: (A ka fana aya ninnu kɛ: ( Huwa al-awwalu, waal-akhiru, waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleem))

136.translation: (Ala ye, kɛ min yem n ma a ɲɛ, min yem tɛ, i nafa la kɛ n soxla tɛ mɔ̀gɔ tɔ̀w la.)
136.instruction: (Allahummak-finee bihalalika AAan haramik, wa-aghninee bifadlika AAamman siwak.)

137.translation: (Ala ye, n bɛ kan kan i la gɛlɛya ani son la, doole tɛ ani kaɲi la, cɛru ani cɛri la, cɛru giran ani mɔ̀gɔw yɛrɛ n kan la.)
137.instruction: (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-hammi walhuzn, walAAajzi walkasali walbukhli waljubn, wadalAAid-dayni waghalabatir-rijal.)

138.translation: (Othmaan Ibn Al-AAas kuma: n fɔra 'A Ala Kɛmɛ, tiɲɛ na setani bɛ don n ani n sariya ani n kalanni cɛ, a bɛ n sotti' Ala Kɛmɛ nangu 'O ye setani ye min tɔ̀gɔ̀ Khanzab, o de k'a n'i y'a mɛn, i ka kan kan Ala la a la, i ka tu i cɛmana saba kɔ (tu min bɛ mɔgɔ fɛ ni ji dɔɔni).)

139.translation: (Ala ye, nɔɔsɔ tɛ yen fo min i y'a kɛ nɔɔsɔ, i bɛ gɛlɛya kɛ, n'i b'a feera, nɔɔsɔ.)
139.instruction: (Allahumma la sahla illa ma jaAAaltahu sahla, wa-anta tajAAalul- hazana in shi'ta sahla.)

140.translation: (Jòn min bɛ juruya kɛ, o kɔfɛ a ka wuudu kɛ, a ka sariya fila kɛ (lii lu, fila rakAAah) o kɔfɛ a ka Ala yafa ɲini, Ala bɛ a yafa.)

143.translation: (Kurana kalanni ani kuma ani ɲini sɛbɛw tiɲɛw.)(i k'a 'Kana i so kɛ yàqw cogo, tiɲɛ na setaniw bɛ sotti so min na soorat Al-Baqarah kalanna' Muslim kuma 1/539, fana ɲini ani kuma sɔ̀gɔ̀ma ani wula, sunɔgɔ ɲɛ na, wuli tuma, soo don ani bɔ, misiri don ani bɔ, ayat Al-kursiyy kalanni ani aya fila banbaw soorat Al-Baqarah sunɔgɔ ɲɛ na, azan…ani tɔ̀w.)

144.translation: (Ala y'a cira, min A b'a feera A b'a kɛ.)(kɔn tiɲɛ na 'N'a' bɛ setani baara don.)

145.translation: Ala ka i barika i nafa min A y'i, i ka (ba kura) i ni ce, den ka a waatiw se, i ka a ɲɛ kɛ. Mɔ̀gɔ min ñu baaraa bɛ nangu: Ala ka i barika, A ka a barika i kan, Ala ka i sara ɲuman ani ka a kelenya i ma ani ka i sara ca.
145.instruction: Baarakallaahu laka fil-mawhoobi laka, wa shakartal-waahiba, wa balagha 'ashuddahu, wa ruzigta birrahu.  Mɔ̀gɔ min ñu baaraa bɛ nangu: Baarakallahu laka wa baaraka 'alayka, wa jazaakallaahu khayran, wa razaqakallaahu mithlahu, wa 'ajzala thawaabaka.

146.translation: (Ibn AAabbas kuma ne Ala Kɛmɛ y'Al-Hasan ani Al-Husayn d'a aarayali ma Ala, a bɛ fɔ: (N b'aw fila d'a aarayali ma Ala kuma dafalenw la setani o setani, màrkàndam o màrkàndam, nyɛ jugu o nyɛ jugu la.))
146.instruction: (Ibn AAabbas kuma ne Ala Kɛmɛ y'Al-Hasan ani Al-Husayn d'a aarayali ma Ala, a bɛ fɔ:(OAAeethukuma bikalimatil-lahit-tammah, min kulli shaytanin wahammah, wamin kulli AAaynin lammah.))

147.translation: (A tɛ foyi, n'Ala b'a fe, a bena i saniyaya kɛ.)

148.translation: (N b'a ɲini Ala Nɔgɔnya ye, cɛba ɲuman man tigi ye, ko a ka i fosaba.)(7 ci)(a bena fosaba.)

149.translation: (Ali Ibn Abee Talib kuma ne ko a mèn Ala Kɛmɛ ko: 'N'a mɔ̀gɔ kelen b'a balɛ muso nɛnɛ tɔmɔtɔ kɛ, o bɛ i ko a bɛ taama ka jennabari sɛnsɛnw ɲini fo a sigi, n'a sigi, nafɛ bɛ a dɔgɔ, n'a o sɔgɔma ye, malaikaw baara tangan bɛ kuma a kan fo wula, n'a o wula ye, malaikaw baara tangan bɛ kuma a kan fo sɔgɔma.)

150.translation: 'Ala ye, yafe n ma, nafe n, i ka n bila mɔ̀gɔ cɛba manw ɲa.

151.translation: ('Aa.ishah (Ala ka a nɛɛ ɲi) kuma ne ko Ala Nabi (Ala ka a barika ani a hɛrɛ) [a balɛ min na a tunan] bɛ a bolonw sɔ ji na k'a nɛ fɔ k'a fɔ: 'Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, tiɲɛ na tunan bɛ lasakarati.'
151.instruction: 'Aa.ishah (radhi-yAllaahu 'anhaa) kuma ne ko Ala Nabi (sal-Allaahu 'alayhe wa sallam) [a balɛ min na a tunan] bɛ a bolonw sɔ ji na k'a nɛ fɔ k'a fɔ:[La ilaha illal-lah, inna lilmawti lasakarat.] 'Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, tiɲɛ na tunan bɛ lasakarati.'

152.translation: (Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, Ala bɛ bonba. Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, A kelen. Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, A kelen, ɲɔgɔ tɛ. Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, masa bɛɛ bɛ A ye ani kumaɲi. Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, se ani fanga tɛ Ala la dɔrɔn.)
152.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar, la ilaha illal-lahu wahdah, la shareeka lah, la ilaha illal-lahu lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, la ilaha illal-lah, wala hawla wala quwwata illa billah.)

153.translation: o kɔrɔ ko mɔ̀gɔ minw bɛ balɛ la, u ka a lajɛ ani a ka a to ko a ka shahadah fɔ. (Mɔ̀gɔ min kuma banbaw bɛ: (Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ.) a bena jennabari don.)
153.instruction: o kɔrɔ ko mɔ̀gɔ minw bɛ balɛ la, u ka a lajɛ ani a ka a to ko a ka shahadah fɔ. (Mɔ̀gɔ min kuma banbaw bɛ: (La ilaha illal-lah.) a bena jennabari don.)

154.translation: (An bɛ Ala ma ani An bɛ A la. Ala ye, sara n ma n sariya na, i ka a lamɛ n ma ɲuman ye.)
154.instruction: (Inna lillahi wa-inna ilayhi rajiAAoon, allahumma/- jurnee fee museebatee wakhluf lee khayran minha.)

155.translation: (Ala ye, yafe -nin na min tunan- ani a ka a jeli don mɔ̀gɔ ɲumanw cɛ, i ka a kɛ a mɔ̀gɔ minw bɛ a kɔ ye la, i ka an yafe ani a ye, An soba dunyaw ye. I ka a kaba ɲi a ma, i ka a nɛ a ma.)(Nin bɛ fɔ: mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ tɔmɔtɔ kɛ a tɛ tuma wa a tunan. O bɛ khaliifa kuma kɔrɔ tiɲɛ ye; don o don, Adam bɛ Ala khaliifa (i ko mɔ̀gɔw bɛ a kɛ) dunya na ko Ala ti tɛ, A ti tunan. Nini nin bɛ kuma o kɔrɔ tiɲɛ jira ani a jira ko Ala bɛ an kɔnɔ ani A bɛ an mɔ̀gɔ minw mara minw an bɛ u bila an tunan wa an tɛ (a ka nini #198 jira fana).)
155.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir li-name the dead- warfaAA darajatahu fil-mahdiyyeen, wakhlufhu fee AAaqibihi fil-ghabireen, waghfir lana walahu ya rabbal-AAalameen wafsah lahu fee qabrih, wanawwir lahu feeh.)

156.translation: (Ala ye, yafe a ma ani nafe a, a tɔgɔ a ma ani a bɔgɔ, i ka a se ɲuman kɛ. I ka a donbaati caya, i ka a kɛ ji, ɲɛ, ani muri la, i ka a saniya jurutiw la i ko saniya farin bɛ saniya juru la. I ka a so lamɛ so ɲuman ye, a baara mɔ̀gɔ ɲumanw ye, a mɔ̀gɔtɔ ɲuman ye. I ka a don jennabari na, a kana a jabaya kaba sariya ani tasuma sariya la.)
156.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lahu warhamh, waAAafihi, waAAfu AAanh, wa-akrim nuzulah, wawassiAA mudkhalah, waghsilhu bilma-i waththalji walbarad, wanaqqihi minal-khataya kama naqqaytath-thawbal-abyada minad-danas, wa-abdilhu daran khayran min darih, wa-ahlan khayran min ahlih wazawjan khayran min zawjih, wa-adkhilhul-jannah, wa-aAAithhu min AAathabil-qabr, waAAathabin-nar)

157.translation: (Ala ye, yafe an nɛnɛw ani an tunanw, an minw bɛ nin ani minw tɛ nin, an denmisɛnw ani an kɔrɔbaw, an cɛw ani an musow. Ala ye, mɔ̀gɔ min i b'a la an cɛ islamiya kan, i ka a tunan eeman kan. Ala ye, kana a sara denya an ma, kana an tɛɲɛ a kɔ.)
157.instruction: (Allahummagh-fir lihayyina wamayyitina washahidina, wagha-ibina, wasagheerina wakabeerina, wathakarina wa-onthana. Allahumma man ahyaytahu minna fa-ahyihi AAalal-islam, waman tawaffaytahu minna fatawaffahu AAalal-eeman, allahumma la tahrimna ajrah, wala tudillana baAAdah.)

158.translation: (Ala ye, o-mɔ̀gɔ bɛ i la jɛ ani i la kana, i ka a kana kaba sɛni ani tasuma sariya. Tiɲɛ na i bɛ wafa ani tiɲɛ. Yafe a ma ani nafe a, tiɲɛ na i y'a yafela ka ca, i bɛ nafe ka ca.)
158.instruction: (Allahumma inna -name the dead- fee thimmatik, wahabli jiwarik, faqihi min fitnatil-qabr waAAathabin-nar, wa-anta ahlul-wafa/, walhaq, faghfir lahu warhamh, innaka antal-ghafoorur-raheem.)

159.translation: (Ala ye, i baara ani i baara muso den bɛ i nafe kama, i bɛ bana a sariya la. N'a ɲɛ kɛra, caya a sara, n'a jugu kɛra, lɔ a jurutiw kan.)
159.instruction: (Allahumma AAabduka wabnu amatik, ihtaja ila rahmatik, wa-anta ghaniyyun AAan AAathabih, in kana muhsinan fazid fee hasanatih, wa-in kana museean fatajawaz AAanh.)

160.translation: Ala ye, kana a kaba sariya la. [A ɲi fana ko a fɔ] Ala ye, kɛ a nɛmɔgɔ, cɛmɔgɔ ani kura a ba ani a ba ma ani nangu nangu tigi. Ala ye, kɛ a gira u musuw (ɲuman) na ani a caya u sara. Kɛ a kelen imanbagaw ɲumanw ɲa. Kɛ a Ibrahim mara na. A a mara i nafe la tasuma jahannama sariya la. A a ma so ɲuman ka a so ani baara mɔ̀gɔ ɲumanw ka a baara mɔ̀gɔw. Ala ye, yafe mɔ̀gɔ minw kɛra an ɲɛ (tunan), an den minw tunan, ani minw kɛra an ɲɛ eeman na.
160.instruction: (Allaahumma 'a'ith-hu min 'athaabil-qabri.) [or say:](Allahummaj-AAalhu faratan, wathukhran liwalidayh, washafeeAAan mujaban. Allahumma thaqqil bihi mawazeenahuma wa-aAAthim bihi ojoorahuma, wa-alhiqhu bisalihil-mu'mineen, wajAAalhu fee kafalati Ibraheem, waqihi birahmatika AAathabal-jaheem, wa 'abdilhu daaran khayran min daarihi, wa 'ahlan khayran min 'ahlihi, Allaahum-maghfir li'aslaafinaa, wa afraatinaa wa man sabaqanaa bil'eemaan)

161.translation: (Ala ye, kɛ a nɛmɔgɔ, cɛmɔgɔ ani sara sababu an ma.)

162.translation: (Tiɲɛ na Ala ye, min A ta ani min A di, o bɛɛ bɛ A ye, fɛn bɛɛ bɛ A ɲɔgɔn na a waati cira...o tuma a fɔ ko a ka sabari ani a ka Ala sara jigi.)(Kumaw (faltasbir waltahtasib) bɛ muso saba kuma la, u ka camɛ a mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ kuma la kan.)
162.instruction: (Inna lillahi ma akhath, walahu ma aAAta, wakullu shayin AAindahu bi-ajalin musamma…faltasbir waltahtasib.)

163.translation: (Ala tɔgɔ na ani Ala Kɛmɛ sunnah kan.)

164.translation: Ala ye, yafe a ma. Ala ye, dafa a.

165.translation: (Hɛrɛ bɛ aw kan, kabaw mɔ̀gɔw, imanbagaw ani musulmanw cɛ. Tiɲɛ na an, n'Ala b'a fe, bena aw ɲɔgɔn, an b'a ɲini Ala ka hɛrɛ an ma ani aw.)
165.instruction: (Assalamu AAalaykum ahlad-diyari minal-mu/mineena walmuslimeen, wa-inna in shaal-lahu bikum lahiqoon, nas-alul-laha lana walakumul-AAafiyah.)

166.translation: (Ala ye, N b'a ɲini I ye a ɲɛ ye, N b'a lafi I la a jugu la.)
166.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha.)

167.translation: (Ala ye, N b'a ɲini I ye a ɲɛ ye, ɲɛ min b'a na, ani ɲɛ min a ci, N b'a lafi I la a jugu la, jugu min b'a na, ani jugu min a ci.)
167.instruction: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma feeha, wakhayra ma orsilat bih, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha, washarri ma feeha washarri ma orsilat bih.)

168.translation: (A bɛ saniya, (O) min saninkɛw b'A saniya kuma A kan, malaikaw fana A su la.)

169.translation: (Ala ye, an na sanji di, dɛmɛ sanji, ɲuman ani hɛrɛ sanji, nafa sanji tɛ juguya, sisan tɛ kɔfɛ.)
169.instruction: (Allahummas-qina ghaythan mugheethan maree-an mureeAAan, nafiAAan, ghayra dar, AAajilan ghayra ajil.)

170.translation: (Ala ye, an dɛmɛ, Ala ye, an dɛmɛ, Ala ye, an dɛmɛ.)

171.translation: (Ala ye, a sanji I baaramɔ̀gɔw ani I misiw ye, ka I nafe caya ani ka I so tunanw wuli.)
171.instruction: (Allahummas-qi AAibadak, wabaha-imak, wanshur rahmatak, wa-ahyi baladakal-mayyit.)

172.translation: (Ala ye, a kɛ sanji nafa sanji ye.)

173.translation: (An sanji Ala hɛrɛ ani A nafe la.)

174.translation: (Ala ye, sanji ka an lamɛn an la ma tɛ an kan, Ala ye, (a ka) kɛ kadaw, kɔngɔw, kɔlɔnw ani jiri sisiw kan.)
174.instruction: (Allahumma hawalayna wala AAalayna, allahumma AAalal-akami waththirab, wabutoonil-awdiyah, wamanabitish-shajar.)

175.translation: (Ala bɛ bonba. Ala ye, kalo lɔn an kan kɛnɛya, eeman, hɛrɛ ani islamiya la, ani i ko min b'i nɛɛ ani i b'a nɛɛ. An soba ani aw soba bɛ Ala ye.)
175.instruction: (Allahu akbar, allahumma ahillahu AAalayna bil-amni wal-eeman, wassalamati wal-islam, wattawfeeiqi lima tuhibbu watarda, rabbuna warabbukal-lah.)

176.translation: (Fɛɛtɛ bɛ tɛmɛ, kɔlɔnw bɛ jira, sara bɛ cira, n'Ala b'a fe.)

177.translation: (Ala ye, N b'a ɲini I ye I nafe la min bɛ fɛn bɛɛ kɔnɔ, ko I ka n yafe.)
177.instruction: (Allahumma inne as-aluka birahmatikal-latee wasiAAat kulla shay, an taghfira lee.)

178.translation: (N'i bɛ fɛɛn dunni, i ka fɔ:(Bismil-lah.)n'i ɲinina a fɔ a daminɛ ɲɛ, i ka fɔ (n'i hakili):Ala tɔgɔ na a daminɛ ani a ban na.)
178.instruction: (N'i bɛ fɛɛn dunni, i ka fɔ:(Bismil-lah.)n'i ɲinina a fɔ a daminɛ ɲɛ, i ka fɔ (n'i hakili):Bismil-lahi fee awwalihi wa-akhirih.)

179.translation: (Mɔ̀gɔ min Ala bɛ fɛɛn di, a ka fɔ:(Ala ye, barika a an ma, i ka an fɛɛn di a ɲɛ.) ani mɔ̀gɔ min Ala bɛ nono di, a ka fɔ:(Ala ye, barika a an ma i ka an di a ca.))
179.instruction: (Mɔ̀gɔ min Ala bɛ fɛɛn di, a ka fɔ:(Allahumma barik lana feehi wa-atAAimna khayran minh.) ani mɔ̀gɔ min Ala bɛ nono di, a ka fɔ:(Allahumma barik lana feehi wazidna minh.))

180.translation: Kumaɲi bɛɛ bɛ Ala ye min fɛɛn n ma ani a di n ma, n se tɛ n fanga tɛ.
180.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee atAAamanee hatha warazaqaneehi min ghayri hawlin minnee wala quwwah.)

181.translation: (Ala ka kumaɲi ca, ɲuman, barika, kumaɲi min ti ban, kumaɲi min an ti bila, kumaɲi min tɛ bɔ, A bɛ an soba.)(Fɛɛn caman bɛ nini nin kɔrɔ la, u la: Ala ka kumaɲi ca, ɲuman, barika. A bɛ O min bɛ wa, A bɛ fɛɛn di ani A ti di, O min bɛ jigi, ani min b'A ɲɔgɔn na ani O min bɛ mago, A bɛ an soba.)
181.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahi hamdan katheeran tayyiban mubarakan feeh, ghayra makfiyyin wala muwaddaAAin, wala mustaghnan AAanhu rabbuna.)

182.translation: (Ala ye, barika u ma min I y'u, yafe u ma ani nafe u.)
182.instruction: (Allahumma barik lahum feema razaqtahum, waghfir lahum warhamhum.)

183.translation: (Ala ye, fɛɛn di mɔ̀gɔ min fɛɛn n ma, i ka ji di mɔ̀gɔ min ji n ma.)
183.instruction: (Allahumma atAAim man atAAamanee wasqi man saqanee.)

184.translation: (Sunbaw ka u sun kɛ i so na, mɔ̀gɔ ɲumanw ani mɔ̀gɔ ɲɛtaw ka i fɛɛn dun, malaikaw ka kuma i kan.)

185.translation: (N'i tɛ wele (fɛɛn la) i ka jaabi. N'i sun bɛ, i ka nini (mɔ̀gɔ minw bɛ nin) ma, n'i tɛ sun, i ka fɛɛn dun.)
185.instruction: (N'i tɛ wele (fɛɛn la) i ka jaabi.  N'i sun bɛ, i ka nini (mɔ̀gɔ minw bɛ nin) ma, n'i tɛ sun, i ka fɛɛn dun.)

187.translation: (Ala ye, barika an jirisɛnsɛnw an ma, barika an dugu an ma, barika an saa an ma, ani barika an mudd an ma.)(Saa kelen bɛ mudd naani, mudd kelen bɛ cɛ juru juru fila kɛnɛ kɛnɛ.)
187.instruction: (Allahumma barik lana fee thamarina, wabarik lana fee madeenatina, wabarik lana fee saAAina wabarik lana fee muddina.)

188.translation: (N'aw kelen bɛ tisi, a ka fɔ:(Kumaɲi bɛɛ bɛ Ala ye.) a nɛnɛ wa a mɔ̀gɔtɔ ka a fɔ: (Ala ka i nafe.) o (mɔ̀gɔ min tisi) b'a jaabi:(Ala ka aw lajɛ, a ka aw kɛnɛ ɲɛ.))
188.instruction: (N'aw kelen bɛ tisi, a ka fɔ:(Alhamdu lillah.) a nɛnɛ wa a mɔ̀gɔtɔ ka a fɔ: (Yarhamukal-lah.) o (mɔ̀gɔ min tisi) b'a jaabi:(Yahdeekumul-lahu wayuslihu balakum.))

189.translation: (Ala ka aw lajɛ, a ka aw kɛnɛ ɲɛ.)

190.translation: (Ala ka i barika (i furuso), a ka i barika, A ka aw fila lajɛ ɲɛ na.)
190.instruction: (Barakal-lahu lak, wabaraka AAalayk, wajamaAAa baynakuma fee khayr.)

191.translation: (n'i bɛ muso furu wa i bɛ baara muso san, i ka fɔ:(Ala ye, N b'a ɲini I ye a ɲɛ min b'a na ani ɲɛ min I kɛra a nɛɛ kan, N b'a lafi I la a jugu min b'a na ani jugu min I kɛra a nɛɛ kan.))(n'i bɛ nɔgo san, i ka a kaba min ani a fɔ o cogo.)
191.instruction: (n'i bɛ muso furu wa i bɛ baara muso san, i ka fɔ: (Allahumma innee as-aluka khayraha wakhayra ma jabaltaha AAalayh, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha washarri ma jabaltaha AAalayh.))(n'i bɛ nɔgo san, i ka a kaba min ani a fɔ o cogo.)

192.translation: (Ala tɔgɔ na. Ala ye, setani kɛ an ma, i ka setani kɛ min I y'an ma.)

193.translation: (N b'a lafi Ala la setani la min bɛ bɔ.)

194.translation: Kumaɲi bɛɛ bɛ Ala ye min n mara min A sɛni i la, min A fisa n ma a mɔ̀gɔ camanw kan.
194.instruction: (Alhamdu lillahil-lathee AAafanee mimmab-talaka bih, wafaddalanee AAala katheerin mimman khalaqa tafdeela.)

195.translation: (Ibn AAumar kuma: a bɛ jate ko Ala Kɛmɛ bɛ fɔ baara ba ba kelen sigi min na a wuli ɲɛ: (N soba ye, yafe n ma ani n sɛgɛn (n jaabi n toba). Tiɲɛ na i bɛ sɛgɛn ka ca, i bɛ yafe ka ca.))
195.instruction: (Ibn AAumar kuma: a bɛ jate ko Ala Kɛmɛ bɛ fɔ baara ba ba kelen sigi min na a wuli ɲɛ: (Rabbigh-fir lee watub AAalay, innaka antat-tawwabul-ghafoor.))

196.translation: (I bɛ saniya Ala ye, N b'i kumaɲi. N bɛ seere ko Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ I tɛ. N b'a ɲini I ye yafe, N bɛ sɛgɛn I ma toba la.)
196.instruction: (Subhanakal-lahumma wabihamdik, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, astaghfiruka wa-atoobu ilayk.)

197.translation: (AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis kuma: 'N taa Nabi lajɛ, n fɛɛn a fɛɛn na, o tuma n a fɔ a ma: (Ala ka i yafe, Ala Kɛmɛ ye.) a jaabi: (ani i fana.)'
197.instruction: (AAabdullah Ibn Sarjis kuma: 'N taa Nabi lajɛ, n fɛɛn a fɛɛn na, o tuma n a fɔ a ma:(Ghafaral-lahu laka ya rasoolal-lah.) a jaabi: (wa-lak))

198.translation: (N'a mɔ̀gɔ bɛ i ɲuman kɛ, i ka fɔ: (Ala ka i sara ɲuman ye.) i b'a kumaɲi tiɲɛ.)
198.instruction: (N'a mɔ̀gɔ bɛ i ɲuman kɛ, i ka fɔ: (Jazakal-lahu khayran.) i b'a kumaɲi tiɲɛ.)

199.translation: (Dajjal: waati banbaw jira cɛbaw ani sɛni cɛbaw minw bena mɔ̀gɔw kan, Nabi bɛɛ b'a ɲa. Mɔ̀gɔ caman bena a kɔ. A bena bɔ Asbahan, Iran, waati min musulmanw bena Constantinople ta. A bena se kɛ, a ka tiɲɛ jira nɔ ye ani nɔ jira tiɲɛ ye. A bena fɔ ko a ɲɛ bɛ, o kɔfɛ a bena fɔ ko a bɛ nabi, a ban na a bena fɔ ko a bɛ ala. A jiraw la: a bena bɛ a nyɛ kinin na, o bɛ tiɲɛ cɛko min b'a kuma kɛ ko a bɛ Ala, bawo o bɛ ɲɛsɩgɛ jira ye. Kuma Kafir bena sɛbɛn a nyɛ fila cɛ, o imanbaga bɛɛ b'a lɔn, karamɔgɔ wa tɛ karamɔgɔ.)(Mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ soorat Al-Kahf aya tan fɔlɔw kɔnɔ, a bena mara Dajjal la.)(A ka fana a lafi Ala la Dajjal sɛniw la tashahhud banbaw kɔfɛ sali na. (A ka nini #55 ani #56 lajɛ.))

200.translation: (O min I nɛɛ n ma, a ka i nɛɛ.)

201.translation: (Ala ka i barika, i baara ani i nafolo.)

202.translation: (Ala ka i barika, i baara ani i nafolo. Tiɲɛ na kumaɲi ani jaabi bɛ san sara ye.)
202.instruction: (Barakal-lahu laka fee ahlika wamalik, innama jaza-os-salafil-hamdu wal-ada'.)

203.translation: (shirk: mɔ̀gɔ tɔw lajɛ Ala la fɛnw la minw bɛ A ma dɔrɔn. O bɛ se kɛ (1) laadaliya na, i ko a laadali ko Ala tɛ mɔ̀gɔ tɔ bɛ se nafa wa juguya kɛ, (2) kuma na, i ko a ka Ala tɛ fɛn ka kasi, (3) baara na, i ko a ka sujudu wa kun Ala tɛ mɔ̀gɔ ma.)(Ala ye, N b'a lafi I la ko N ka shirk kɛ I ye hakili na, N b'a ɲini I ye yafe min N kɛ hakili tɛ.)
203.instruction: (shirk: mɔ̀gɔ tɔw lajɛ Ala la fɛnw la minw bɛ A ma dɔrɔn. O bɛ se kɛ (1) laadaliya na, i ko a laadali ko Ala tɛ mɔ̀gɔ tɔ bɛ se nafa wa juguya kɛ, (2) kuma na, i ko a ka Ala tɛ fɛn ka kasi, (3) baara na, i ko a ka sujudu wa kun Ala tɛ mɔ̀gɔ ma.)(Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika an oshrika bika wa-ana aAAlam, wa-astaghfiruka lima la aAAlam.)

204.translation: (Aaishah kuma ko Ala Kɛmɛ bɛ saga di, a fɔ ko a tila. Waati min baara muso bɛ sɛgɛn (a tila kɔfɛ), AAaishah b'a ɲini: 'U kuma di?', a jaabi: U bɛ nini: (Ala ka aw bɛɛ barika.) AAaishah bɛ fɔ: (Ala ka u fana barika.))(an b'u nini jaabi o cogo kelen na, an sara bɛ an na.)
204.instruction: (Aaishah kuma ko Ala Kɛmɛ bɛ saga di, a fɔ ko a tila. Waati min baara muso bɛ sɛgɛn (a tila kɔfɛ), AAaishah b'a ɲini: 'U kuma di?', a jaabi: U bɛ nini: (Barakal-lahu feekum.) AAaishah bɛ fɔ: (Wafeehim barakal-lah.))(an b'u nini jaabi o cogo kelen na, an sara bɛ an na.)

205.translation: (Nini nin bɛ kɛ waati min mɔ̀gɔ bɛ a miiri fɔlɔ ko fɛn jugu wa ɲuman bɛ jira ɲuman wa jugu, a b'a kɛ a baara sababu ye, nka a bɛ o kɛnɛ bɔ, a b'a jigi Ala kan, o tuma a bɛ nini nin fɔ a jaabi ye, bawo o bɛ shirk kalan na.)(Ala ye, jira tɛ, jigi bɛ I kan dɔrɔn, ɲuman tɛ I ɲuman tɛ, Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ I tɛ.)
205.instruction: (Nini nin bɛ kɛ waati min mɔ̀gɔ bɛ a miiri fɔlɔ ko fɛn jugu wa ɲuman bɛ jira ɲuman wa jugu, a b'a kɛ a baara sababu ye, nka a bɛ o kɛnɛ bɔ, a b'a jigi Ala kan, o tuma a bɛ nini nin fɔ a jaabi ye, bawo o bɛ shirk kalan na.)(Allahumma la tayra illa tayruk, wala khayra illa khayruk, wala ilaha ghayruk.)

206.translation: (Ala tɔgɔ na, kumaɲi bɛɛ bɛ Ala ye. A bɛ saniya, O min nin (taamafɛn) an baara kɛra, an yɛrɛ ti se o la, ani an bɛ an soba ma. Kumaɲi bɛɛ bɛ Ala ye, kumaɲi bɛɛ bɛ Ala ye, kumaɲi bɛɛ bɛ Ala ye, Ala bɛ bonba, Ala bɛ bonba, Ala bɛ bonba. I bɛ saniya Ala ye, tiɲɛ na n jugu n ma, i ka n yafe, tiɲɛ na mɔ̀gɔ tɛ juru yafe I tɛ.)
206.instruction: (Bismil-lah, walhamdu lillah, subhanal-lathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanakal-lahumma innee thalamtu nafsee faghfir lee fainnahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.)

207.translation: (Ala bɛ bonba, Ala bɛ bonba, Ala bɛ bonba, A bɛ saniya, O min nin (taamafɛn) an baara kɛra, an yɛrɛ ti se o la, ani an bɛ an soba ma. Ala ye, an b'a ɲini I ye birr ani taqwa an taama nin na, an b'a ɲini I ye baara minw b'i nɛɛ. Ala ye, an taama nɔgɔya, i ka an a janya teliya. Ala ye, I bɛ mɔ̀gɔtɔ taama na ani i bɛ kɔnɔtigi baara kan.)
207.instruction: (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, subhanal-lathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineen, wa-inna ila rabbina lamunqaliboon, allahumma inna nas-aluka fee safarina hatha albirra wattaqwa, waminal-AAamali ma tarda, allahumma hawwin AAalayna safarana hatha, watwi AAanna buAAdah, allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar, walkhaleefatu fil-ahl, allahumma innee aAAoothu bika min waAAtha-is-safar, waka-abatil-manthar, wasoo-il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl.)(upon returning the same supplication is recited with the following addition: (Ayiboona, ta-iboona, AAabidoona, lirabbina hamidoon.))

208.translation: (Ala ye, sanjɛw wolonwula soba ani minw u datugu, dunyaw wolonwula soba ani minw u bɛ, setaniw soba ani minw u tɛɲɛ, finjiw soba ani minw u bɛ ta. N b'a ɲini I ye dugu nin ɲɛ ye, a mɔ̀gɔw ɲɛ ani ɲɛ bɛɛ min b'a na, N b'a lafi I la dugu nin jugu la, a mɔ̀gɔw jugu ani jugu bɛɛ min b'a na.)
208.instruction: (Allahumma rabbas-samawatis-sabAAi wama athlaln, warabbal-aradeenas-sabAAi wama aqlaln, warabbash-shayateeni wama adlaln, warabbar-riyahi wama tharayn, as-aluka khayra hathihil-qaryah, wakhayra ahlilha wakhayra ma feeha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharriha washarri ahliha, washarri ma feeha.)

209.translation: (Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, A kelen, ɲɔgɔ tɛ, masa bɛɛ bɛ A ye ani kumaɲi. A bɛ ɲɛnamaya di ani A bɛ sa di, A bɛ ɲɛnamaya na ani A ti sa. ɲɛ bɛɛ bɛ A bolo, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ kan.)
209.instruction: (La ilaha illal-lah,  wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, yuhyee wayumeetu wahuwa hayyun la yamoot, biyadihil-khayru wahuwa  AAala kulli shayin qadeer.)

211.translation: (N b'i kɛ Ala la mara na, A la mara ti ɲinina.)

212.translation: (N b'i diini, i laadaliya ani i baaraw banbaw kɛ Ala la mara na.)

213.translation: (Ala ka i taqwa di, a ka i juru yafe, a ka ɲɛ bɛɛ nɔgɔya i ma, yɔrɔ min i bɛ.)(taqwa: kuma min bɛ baara ɲumanw ani mɛnni bɛɛ kɔrɔ, o kɔrɔ ko baara minw fɔra u kɛ ani minw bɔra u kɛ.)
213.instruction: (Zawwadakal-lahut-taqwa, waghafara thanbak, wayassara lakal-khayra haythuma kunt.)

214.translation: Jabir kuma: Waati min an bɛ kuru kɔnɔ an bɛ fɔ Allaahu 'Akber (Ala bɛ bonba) waati min an bɛ jigin an bɛ fɔ Subhaanallaah (Ala bɛ saniya)

215.translation: (Seere, seere kɛ an Ala kumaɲi la A hɛrɛw ani A nafaw an kan. An soba, an mara, an ɲuman kɛ an kan ani an kana jugu bɛɛ la. N b'a lafi Ala la tasuma la.)
215.instruction: (SamiAAa samiAAun bihamdil-lahi wahusni bala-ihi AAalayna. Rabbana sahibna wa-afdil AAalayna AAa-ithan billahi minan-nar.)

216.translation: (N b'a lafi Ala kuma dafalenw la jugu min A da.)

217.translation: (Ibn AAumar kuma ne ko Ala Kɛmɛ kɛlɛ kɔfɛ wa hajji kɔfɛ bɛ fɔ kuru bɛɛ kan: (Ala bɛ bonba, Ala bɛ bonba, Ala bɛ bonba.) o tuma a bɛ fɔ: (Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, A kelen, ɲɔgɔ tɛ. Masa bɛɛ bɛ A ye ani kumaɲi, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ kan. An bɛ sɛgɛn, toba, sinji ani an soba kumaɲi. Ala dafa A laada, A dɛmɛ A baaramɔ̀gɔ, A kelen se kɛlɛcɛw lajɛ.))
217.instruction: (Ibn AAumar kuma ne ko Ala Kɛmɛ kɛlɛ kɔfɛ wa hajji kɔfɛ bɛ fɔ kuru bɛɛ kan: (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.) o tuma a bɛ fɔ: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer, ayiboona ta-iboon, AAabidoon, lirabbina hamidoon, sadaqal-lahu waAAdah, wanasara AAabdah, wahazamal-ahzaba wahdah.))

218.translation: Waati min fɛn kɛra a nɛɛ, Nabi bɛ fɔ:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)). Kumaɲi bɛ Ala ye min A barikaw la ɲɛ bɛɛ dafa. N'a fɛn kɛra a nɛɛ tɛ, a bɛ fɔ:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)). Kumaɲi bɛ Ala ye kɛnɛ bɛɛ na.
218.instruction: Waati min fɛn kɛra a nɛɛ, Nabi bɛ fɔ:((Alhamdu lillaahil-lathee bini'matihi tatimmuus-saalihaat)).N'a fɛn kɛra a nɛɛ tɛ, a bɛ fɔ:((Alhamdulillaahi 'alaa kulli haal)).

219.translation: (Nabi (PBUH) kuma: 'Mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ salawati n kan, Ala bɛ tan a kan.)

220.translation: (A (PBUH) kuma fana: 'Kana n kaba kɛ baara yɔrɔ ye. Salawati n kan, tiɲɛ na aw salawati bɛ se n ma yɔrɔ min aw bɛ.)

221.translation: (A (PBUH) kuma fana: 'Jitɔ bɛ mɔ̀gɔ min, n'a tɔgɔ fɔra a ma, a bɛ salawati n kan kɛ.)

222.translation: Nabi [PBUH] kuma: 'Tiɲɛ na Ala bɛ malaikaw minw bɛ dunya taama, u bɛ n ummah (jama) salamu (wa hɛrɛ nini) n ma.

223.translation: Nabi [PBUH] kuma: 'Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ salamu (wa hɛrɛ nini) n kan fo Ala bɛ n niyɔrɔ sɛgɛn n ma, ko N ka a salamu jaabi.

224.translation: (Ala Kɛmɛ kuma: 'Aw ti jennabari don fo aw bɛ iman, aw ti iman fo aw bɛ ɲɔgɔn nɛɛ. N ka aw fɔ fɛn ye, n'aw kɛra a kan, aw bena ɲɔgɔn nɛɛ tiɲɛ? Salamu caya aw cɛ.)

225.translation: (Aammar kuma: 'Kɛnɛ saba, mɔ̀gɔ min b'u lajɛ, a dafa a iman: a ka tiɲɛ kɛ, a ka salamu mɔ̀gɔ bɛɛ ma, ani a ka (sara) di a dɔɔni na.)

226.translation: (Aabdullah Ibn Aamr kuma ne ko cɛ kelen ɲini Nabi: 'Islamiya min ɲɛ ka ca?'. A jaabi: Fɛɛn di (gɔsibagaw ma), salamu mɔ̀gɔ min i b'a lɔn ani min i t'a lɔn.)

227.translation: (N'a kitabu mɔ̀gɔw salamu i, jaabi fɔ: (Ani aw kan.))

228.translation: (N'i mèn sɛgɛkɔkɔ kuma la, ɲini Ala nafa bawo a ye malaika ye, n'i mèn fininbaga kuma la, i lafi Ala la bawo a ye setani ye.)

229.translation: (N'i mèn wulufalaw kuma wa fininbagaw kuma su la, i lafi Ala la bawo u bɛ min ye i tɛ.)

230.translation: (Ala ye, imanbaga o imanbaga min N tɔ̀gɔya, kɛ o sababu ye a ɲɛsin I ma tunan don na.)
230.instruction: (Allahumma fa-ayyuma mu/minin sababtuhu fajAAal thalika lahu qurbatan ilayka yawmal-qiyamah.)

231.translation: (A kuma: 'N'a mɔ̀gɔ kelen bɛ a nɛnɛ kumaɲi, a ka fɔ: 'N b'a miiri o-mɔ̀gɔ ye...Ala b'a jate...N tɛ mɔ̀gɔ si kumaɲi, a kɛ (n kumaɲi) ɲɛ Ala kumaɲi ɲɛ, nka n b'a miiri o ye'...n'a b'a lɔn a ye.)

232.translation: Ala ye, kana n sariya min u bɛ fɔ, yafe n ma min u t'a lɔn [i ka n kɛ ɲuman ye ka u miiri].
232.instruction: Allaahumma laa tu'aakhithnee bimaa yaqooloona, waghfir lee maa laa ya'lamoona [waj'alnee khayram-mimmaa yadhunnoon]

233.translation: (N bɛ nin Ala ye, (I wele jaabi la), n bɛ nin. N bɛ nin, ɲɔgɔ tɛ I ye, n bɛ nin. Tiɲɛ na kumaɲi bɛɛ, hɛrɛ ani masa bɛ I ye. ɲɔgɔ tɛ I ye.)
233.instruction: (Labbaykal-lahumma labbayk, labbayka la shareeka laka labbayk, innal-hamda wanniAAmata laka walmulk, la shareeka lak.)

234.translation: (Nabi lamɛnna KaAAbah kan nɔgo kan, waati o waati a se jigiba ma a b'a jira a kalan na ka fɔ: (Ala bɛ bonba))
234.instruction: (Nabi lamɛnna KaAAbah kan nɔgo kan, waati o waati a se jigiba ma a b'a jira a kalan na ka fɔ: (Allahu akbar))

235.translation: Nabi PBUH bɛ fɔ Yemeni kɔnɔ ani jigiba cɛ: (An soba ye, an di ɲuman ye dunya nin na ani ɲuman ye kɔfɛ na, an kana tasuma sariya la.)
