235.instruction: Nabi PBUH bɛ fɔ Yemeni kɔnɔ ani jigiba cɛ: (Rabbana atina fee alddunya hasanatan wafee al-akhirati hasanatan waqina  AAathaba alnnar)[Al-Baqarah: 201]

236.translation: (Jabir kuma a Nabi hajji kuma na: '...waati min a ɲɛsinna Safa kuru ma a kalan: (Tiɲɛ na Safa ani Marwah bɛ Ala sinji yɔrɔw la...) (N bɛ daminɛ min Ala daminɛ.) a daminɛna Safa, a k'a kɔnɔ fo a ye KaAAbah, a ɲɛ a ma k'a fɔ: (Ala bɛ bonba, Ala bɛ bonba, Ala bɛ bonba.) o tuma a bɛ ninnaw fɔ saba saba, nini (mɔ̀gɔ ka a nini yɛrɛ kɛ) o o kɔfɛ: (Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, A kelen, ɲɔgɔ tɛ. Masa bɛɛ bɛ A ye ani kumaɲi, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ kan. Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ A kelen. A dafa A laada, A dɛmɛ A baaramɔ̀gɔ, A kelen se kɛlɛcɛw lajɛ.)) (a bɛ baara nin tɔ kɛ Marwah la fana.)
236.instruction: (Jabir  said when describing the Prophet’s  pilgrimage: ‘…and when he approached mount Safa he recited: ( Innas-safa wa-almarwata min shaAAa-iri Allah ….) (Abda-o bima badaal-lahu bih.) so he started with Safa and climed it until he could see the KaAAbah, he then faced it and said: (Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.) and then he would say the following three times making a supplication (one should make a personal supplication) after each time: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, la ilaha illal-lahu wahdah, anjaza waAAdah, wanasara AAabdah, wahazamal -ahzaba wahdah.)(he  would repeat this action at Marwah.)

237.translation: (Nini ɲuman ka ca bɛ AAarafah don nini, ɲuman min N ani Nabi minw kɛ n ɲɛ fɔ (bɛ): (Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, A kelen, ɲɔgɔ tɛ. Kumaɲi ani masa bɛ A ye, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ kan.))
237.instruction: (Nini ɲuman ka ca bɛ AAarafah don nini, ɲuman min N ani Nabi minw kɛ n ɲɛ fɔ (bɛ): (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.))

238.translation: Nabi yo a nɔgo Al-Qaswa fo a se yɔrɔ saniya ma (Al-Mash aril Haraam). O tuma a ɲɛ Qiblah ma k'a ɲini Ala, a kuma fo: Allaahu Akbar (Ala bɛ bonba), Allaahu Ahad (Ala kelen) ani Laa ilaaha illallaah (Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ). A sigi fo sanjɛ kɛra jɛ su ɲɛ, o kɔfɛ a tɛmɛna su bɔ ɲɛ.

239.translation: Nabi PBUH fɔ Allaahu 'Akbar (Ala bɛ bonba) kuru o kuru min a tɔn tɛmɛsɛn sabaw kan. O tuma a taa ɲɛ, a sigi ɲɛ Qiblah ma k'a bolow jɛ ka Ala wele. O kɛra (tɔn) tɛmɛsɛn fɔlɔ ani filanan kɔfɛ. Sabanan na, a tɔna a, a fɔ Allahu Akbar kuru o kuru la, nka a bana a bɔ tɛ sigi a la (niniw kama).

242.translation: (Nabi PBUH bɛ sujudu Ala nɛɛ kama n'a kunnafoni sɛgɛnna a nɛɛ wa nisɔndiya.)

243.translation: (A i bolo donbɔ yɔrɔ kan ka fɔ: (Ala tɔgɔ na (saba saba)) o tuma nini wolonwula: (N b'a lafi Ala ani A se la jugu min n b'a a ani min n b'a su.))
243.instruction: (A i bolo donbɔ yɔrɔ kan ka fɔ: (Bismil-lah (three times)) o tuma nini wolonwula: (aAAoothu billahi waqudratih min sharri ma ajidu wa-ohathir.))

244.translation: N'i bɛ fɛn min ye i nɛnɛ la min b'i nɛɛ, wa a yɛrɛ la wa a nafolo la [i ka Ala ɲini a barika a na] bawo ɲɛ jugu bɛ tiɲɛ.

246.translation: (Ala tɔgɔ na, Ala bɛ bonba. Ala ye, (o bɛ) I ye ani A bɛ I ye, Ala ye, nin sɔ n ma.)
246.instruction: (Bismil-lah wallahu akbar, allahumma minka walak, allahumma taqabbal  minnee.)

247.translation: (N b'a lafi Ala kuma dafalenw la minw mɔ̀gɔ ɲuman wa mɔ̀gɔ jugu tɛ tɛmɛ, jugu bɛɛ min A da, A kɛ, A bɔ. (N b'a lafi) jugu min bɛ jigin sanjɛ na ani jugu min bɛ taa a la. (N b'a lafi) jugu min bɛ caya dunya kan ani jugu min bɛ bɔ a na, N b'a lafi sɛni jugu su ani wula la, ani mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ don su la jugu la, fo min bɛ ɲuman, I nafetigi ye.)
247.instruction: (aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammat, allatee la yujawizuhunna barrun wala fajir min sharri ma khalaq, wabaraa watharaa, wamin sharri ma yanzilu minas-sama/, wamin sharri ma yaAAruju feeha, wamin sharri ma tharaa fil-ard, wamin sharri ma yakhruju minha, wamin sharri fitnanil-layli wannahar, wamin sharri kulli tariqin illa tariqan yatruqu bikhayrin ya Rahman.)

248.translation: (Ala Kɛmɛ kuma: 'Ala la, N b'a ɲini yafe ani toba Ala ma, ka ca tangan don kelen na.)

249.translation: (A kuma fana: 'Aw mɔ̀gɔw ye, Toba! Tiɲɛ na N bɛ toba Ala ma, ba ba don kelen na.)

250.translation: (A kuma fana: 'Mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ fɔ:(N b'a ɲini Ala yafe, min tɛ, Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ A tɛ, ɲɛnamayatigi, Fɛnbɛɛ maratigi, N bɛ toba A ma.) Ala b'a yafe, hali n'a bɛ mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ bɔ kɛlɛcɛw ɲɛ.)
250.instruction: (A kuma fana: 'Mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ fɔ:(Astaghfirul-lahal-lathee la ilaha illa huwal-hayyul-qayyoomu wa-atoobu ilayh.) Ala b'a yafe, hali n'a bɛ mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ bɔ kɛlɛcɛw ɲɛ.)

251.translation: (A kuma: 'Soba bɛ ɲɛsin a baaramɔ̀gɔ ma ka ca su cɛla, n'i bɛ se kɛ mɔ̀gɔ minw cɛ Ala b'u hakili waati o, kɛ o.)

252.translation: (A kuma fana: 'Baaramɔ̀gɔ bɛ ɲɛsin a soba ma ka ca a sujudu tuma, i ka nini ca o na.)

253.translation: (A kuma fana: 'tiɲɛ na n hakili bɛ ɲinina, tiɲɛ na N b'a ɲini Ala yafe ba ba don kelen na.)(ɲinina: o kɔrɔ ko 'ɲinina' kɛnɛ na. Nabi bɛ a soba hakili caya tuma bɛɛ, Ala ɲɛsini ani Ala hakili sariya cogo min na, n'a caya o dɔɔni cogo o, a b'a kɛ juru ye, o tuma a bɛ yafe ɲini Ala ma teliya.)

254.translation: (Mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ fɔ:(Ala bɛ saniya, N b'A kumaɲi.) ba ba don kelen na, a jurutiw bɛ ɲin, hali n'u bɛ i ko kɔgɔji fɛɛ.)
254.instruction: (Mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ fɔ:(Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih.) ba ba don kelen na, a jurutiw bɛ ɲin, hali n'u bɛ i ko kɔgɔji fɛɛ.)

255.translation: (Abu Hurayrah kuma ne ko Ala Kɛmɛ kuma: 'Mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ fɔ: (Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, A kelen, ɲɔgɔ tɛ. Masa bɛɛ bɛ A ye ani kumaɲi, A bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ kan.) ba ba don kelen na, a bɛ baara ba sara mɔ̀gɔ tan bɔli, baara ɲuman ba ba bɛ sɛbɛn a ma, baara jugu ba ba bɛ ɲin, a bɛ mara setani la don o fo wula, mɔ̀gɔ tɛ na fɛn ɲuman tɛmɛna fo mɔ̀gɔ min kɛra ka ca.)
255.instruction: (Abu Hurayrah  reported that the Messenger of Allah  said: ‘Whoever says: (La ilaha illal-lahu wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer.) a hundred times during the day, has the reward of freeing ten slaves, a hundred good deeds are recorded for him and a hundred bad deeds are wiped away and he has gained refuge from the devil that day until evening and none shall come with anything better except someone who has done more.)

256.translation: (Aboo Hurayrah kuma ne ko Ala Kɛmɛ kuma:'Kuma fila, (minw) yɛlɛ nɛnɛ kan, gira musu kan, nɛɛ Nafetigi ma: (Ala bɛ saniya, N b'A kumaɲi. Ala bɛ saniya, Nɔgɔnya.)
256.instruction: (Aboo Hurayrah kuma ne ko Ala Kɛmɛ kuma:'Kuma fila, (minw) yɛlɛ nɛnɛ kan, gira musu kan, nɛɛ Nafetigi ma: (Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, wasubhanal-lahil-AAatheem.))

257.translation: (Aboo Hurayrah kuma ne ko Ala Kɛmɛ kuma: 'Fɔli: (Ala bɛ saniya, kumaɲi bɛɛ bɛ Ala ye. Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, Ala bɛ bonba.) bɛ n nɛɛ ka ca fɛn bɛɛ min tile bɔra a kan.)
257.instruction: (Aboo Hurayrah kuma ne ko Ala Kɛmɛ kuma: 'Fɔli: (Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah wallahu akbar.) bɛ n nɛɛ ka ca fɛn bɛɛ min tile bɔra a kan.)

258.translation: (Sa'd kuma: 'An sigina Ala Kɛmɛ ɲɔgɔn na, a kuma: 'Aw la mɔ̀gɔ tɛ se baara ɲuman ba saba ba don kelen na?' Mɔ̀gɔ kelen a ɲini: Cogo di mɔ̀gɔ bɛ baara ɲuman ba saba sɛ? A jaabi: 'A ka fɔ: (Ala bɛ saniya.) ba ba, baara ɲuman ba saba bɛ sɛbɛn a ma wa baara jugu ba saba bɛ ɲin.)
258.instruction: (Sa'd kuma: 'An sigina Ala Kɛmɛ ɲɔgɔn na, a kuma: 'Aw la mɔ̀gɔ tɛ se baara ɲuman ba saba ba don kelen na?' Mɔ̀gɔ kelen a ɲini: Cogo di mɔ̀gɔ bɛ baara ɲuman ba saba sɛ? A jaabi: 'A ka fɔ: (Subhanal-lah.) ba ba, baara ɲuman ba saba bɛ sɛbɛn a ma wa baara jugu ba saba bɛ ɲin.)

259.translation: (Jabbir kuma ne ko Nabi kuma: 'Mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ fɔ: (Ala bɛ saniya, Nɔgɔnya, N b'A kumaɲi.) tɛrɛ jiri bɛ sin a ma jennabari na.)
259.instruction: (Jabbir kuma ne ko Nabi kuma: 'Mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ fɔ: (Subhanal-lahil-AAatheemi wabihamdih.) tɛrɛ jiri bɛ sin a ma jennabari na.)

260.translation: (AAabdullah Ibn Qays kuma ne ko Nabi a fɔ a ma: 'AAabdullah Ibn Qays, N ka aw fɔ kura ye jennabari kurasu la?' A o tuma a fɔ: 'Fɔ: (Se tɛ fanga tɛ Ala la dɔrɔn.))
260.instruction: (AAabdullah Ibn Qays kuma ne ko Nabi a fɔ a ma: 'AAabdullah Ibn Qays, N ka aw fɔ kura ye jennabari kurasu la?' A o tuma a fɔ: 'Fɔ: (La  hawla wala quwwata illa billah.))

261.translation: (kuma minw bɛ Ala nɛɛ ka ca bɛ naani: (Ala bɛ saniya, kumaɲi bɛɛ bɛ Ala ye. Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, Ala bɛ bonba.))(a tɛ don min i bɛ daminɛ.)
261.instruction: (kuma minw bɛ Ala nɛɛ ka ca bɛ naani: (Subhanal-lah, walhamdu lillah, wala ilaha illal-lah, wallahu akbar.))(a tɛ don min i bɛ daminɛ.)

262.translation: (SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas kuma ne ko cɛ kelen nana Ala Kɛmɛ ma k'a fɔ a ma: 'Kalan n fɛn min n ka fɔ?' A kuma: 'Fɔ: (Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ, A kelen ɲɔgɔ tɛ. Ala bɛ bonba ka ca ani kumaɲi ca bɛ Ala ye. Ala bɛ saniya, dunyaw soba. Se tɛ fanga tɛ Ala la dɔrɔn, Seba, Hakilitigi.) cɛ o tuma a kuma: 'Ninw bɛ n soba ma, min bɛ n ma?' A jaabi: 'Fɔ:(Ala ye, yafe n ma, nafe n, n lajɛ ani n ruziqi di.))
262.instruction: (SaAAd Ibn Abee Waqqas  narrated that a man came to the Messenger of Allah  and said to him: ‘Teach me something which I should say?’ He said: ‘Say: (La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, Allahu akbaru kabeera, walhamdu lillahi katheera, subhanal-lahi rabbil-AAalameen, la hawla wala quwwata illa billahil-AAazeezil-hakeem.) the man then said: ‘These are for my Lord, and what is for me?’ He  replied: ‘Say:(Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, warzuqnee.))

263.translation: (Tariq Al-AshjaAAee kuma: 'Waati min mɔ̀gɔ bɛ islamiya sɔ, Nabi b'a kalan a sali kɛcogo, o tuma a b'a fɔ ko a ka nini kuma ninnaw na: (Ala ye, yafe n ma, nafe n, n lajɛ, n hɛrɛ di ani n ruziqi di.))
263.instruction: (Tariq Al-AshjaAAee kuma: 'Waati min mɔ̀gɔ bɛ islamiya sɔ, Nabi b'a kalan a sali kɛcogo, o tuma a b'a fɔ ko a ka nini kuma ninnaw na: (Allahummagh-fir lee, warhamnee, wahdinee, waAAafinee warzuqnee.))

264.translation: (Jabir Ibn 'AAabdullah kuma ne ko Ala Kɛmɛ kuma: 'Tiɲɛ na, nini ɲuman ka ca bɛ: (Kumaɲi bɛɛ bɛ Ala ye.) ani tiɲɛ na, hakili ɲuman ka ca bɛ: (Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ.))
264.instruction: (Jabir Ibn 'AAabdullah kuma ne ko Ala Kɛmɛ kuma: 'Tiɲɛ na, nini ɲuman ka ca bɛ: (Alhamdu lillah) ani tiɲɛ na, hakili ɲuman ka ca bɛ: (La ilaha illal-lah.))

265.translation: Baara ɲumanw minw bɛ tɛmɛ bɛ 'Ala bɛ saniya', 'Kumaɲi bɛ Ala ye', 'Mɔ̀gɔ tɛ Ala tɛ', 'Ala bɛ bonba', ani 'Se tɛ fanga tɛ Ala la dɔrɔn'
265.instruction: The good deeds which endure are 'Subhaanallaah.', and 'Walhamdulillaah.', and 'Wa laa ilaaha illallaah'., and 'Wallaahu Akbar',and 'Wa laa hawla wa laa guwawala illaa billaah'.

266.translation: (Tasbeeh, o kɔrɔ nin na, a fɔ: (Subhanal-lah, alhamdu lillah, Allahu akbar.)) (AAabdullah Ibn AAamr kuma: 'N ye Nabi tasbeeh kɛ a bolo kinin na.)

267.translation: N'a wula bɛ don, aw denw don so na bawo setaniw bɛ jɛ waati o. O kɔfɛ su waati kelen (o kɔrɔ su waati fɔlɔ) tɛmɛna, (aw bɛ se) u (denw) bila. Aw daaw datugu aw bɛ Ala tɔgɔ fɔ, bawo setani tɛ da datugulen da. Aw ji kɛnɛw min aw bɛ Ala tɔgɔ fɔ. Aw fɛɛn kɛnɛw datugu aw bɛ Ala tɔgɔ fɔ hali n'i bɛ fɛn dɔrɔn a kan, aw fitiliw fi. Hɛrɛ ani barika bɛ an Nabi Muhammad kan, a baara kan ani a mɔ̀gɔtɔw kan, u bɛɛ.

name-1.instruction: O min bɛ ɲɛ ani nafa fɛ a fɛn daw bɛɛ ma | Quran: (1:3) (17:110)

name-2.instruction: O min bɛ baara kɛ nafa caya la | Quran: (2:163) (3: 31) (4:100) (5:3)

name-3.instruction: Masa soba, O min bɛ mara dafalen, O min mara bɛ saniya ɲɛsɩgɛ tɛ | Quran: (20:114)(23:116)(59:23)(62:1)

name-4.instruction: O min bɛ saniya ɲɛsɩgɛ bɛɛ la, den ani jɛɲɔgɔn tɛ A ma | Quran: (59:23) (62:1)

name-5.instruction: O min bɛ hɛrɛ, kɛnɛ ani hɛrɛ di. N'an bɛ tɔgɔ nin fɔ, an bɛ hɛrɛ kɛ an yɛrɛ ani an lamɛn mɔ̀gɔw ma. | Quran: (59:23)

name-6.instruction: Tɔgɔ nin bɛ gɛlɛ hali musulmanw ma bawo 'Al-Mu'min' bɔ 'Al-iman' tɔgɔ la min kɔrɔ ko laadali, o na 'Al-Mu'minoune' tɔgɔ bɔ min kɔrɔ ko imanbagaw, a bɛ Kurana tɔgɔ ye mɔ̀gɔ minw bɛ iman fɛn wɔɔrɔ la: Ala kelenya, malaikaw sigi, kitaabu saniyaw (Torah, Injil ani Zabur tɛ camɛ ani Kurana), nabiw, don banba (sariya don) ani cira a jugu ani a ɲɛ. Tɔgɔ nin kɔrɔ tiɲɛ bɛ gɛlɛ ka a lamɛn a kɔrɔ fɔlɔ na nka a bɛ se faamu a jiri ani a gundow la. | Quran: (59:23)

name-7.instruction: O min bɛ A fɛn daw mara A se la fɛn bɛɛ na, kɛnɛ wa fɛn tɛ dunya nin wa tɔ na bɔ A fe | Quran: (59:23)

name-8.instruction: A bɛ bonba A cɛba ani A bonba la, El-Aziz kɔrɔ fɛn kelen na ko o mɔ̀gɔ min bɛ nɔgɔ ani nɔgɔya A fɛn daw ɲɛ na. A tɛ fɛn si baaramɔ̀gɔ ye, fɛn si t'A fɔ min a ka kɛ. | Quran: (3:6)(4:15 8)(9:40)(4 8:7)

name-9.instruction: Cɛba, se banbaw A bonba ani A fanga tɛ dan na. Waati min A bɛ jahiliw (tɛtiɲɛw ani jurubagaw) bɩ A bɛ A sariya kɛ tiɲɛ na. | Quran: (59:23)

name-10.instruction: O min ka ca A fɛn daw ma, fɛn tɛ se ko a bɛ cɛba | Quran: (59:23)

name-11.instruction: Fɛn sigi bɛɛ datigi, ɲɛnamaya wa tunan, taa wa sigi. | Quran: (6:102)(13:16)(39:62)(40:62)(59:24)

name-12.instruction: O min bɛ A fɛn daw jɛ juru ani ɲɛsɩgɛ bɛɛ kan. | Quran: (59:24)

name-13.instruction: O min bɛ ɲɛ ani jira fɛn o fɛn ma a kɔnɔ ani a kɔ. Kɛrɛn arabuya na, kuma nin kɔrɔ ko fɛn dilannikɛla, sisanra arabuya na a kɔrɔ ko dilannikɛla. | Quran: (59:24)

name-14.instruction: O min bɛ yafe min A b'a fe mɔ̀gɔ min A b'a fe ma. | Quran: (20:82)(38:66)(39:5)(40:42)(71:10)

name-15.instruction: O min bɛ se fɛn daw jɔ A fe la. | Quran: (13:16)(14:48)(38:65)(39:4)(40:16)

name-16.instruction: O min bɛ di caya tɛ fɛn sɔ a nɔ na. | Quran: (3:8)(38:9)(38:35)

name-17.instruction: O min bɛ fɛn o fɛn di min a b'a mago. | Quran: (51:58)

name-18.instruction: A dɔrɔn bɛ kunkɔ ani gundo kɔlɔnw lɔn A dɔnniya ani A hakili la. Tɔgɔ nin bɛ tɛmɛ tɔgɔ 'Al-'Alīm' la. | Quran: (34:26)

name-19.instruction: O min ma fɛn tɛ dogo, bawo A bɛ fɛn bɛɛ lɔn ani A bɛ fɛn bɛɛ dɔn. | Quran: (2:158)(3:92)(4:35)(24:41)(33:40)

name-20.instruction: O min bɛ A ɲɛ min a hakili kan. | Quran: (2:245)

name-21.instruction: O min bɛ bɔ, a caya ani a ɲɛ A ɲɛ a hakili kan. | Quran: (2:245)

name-22.instruction: O min bɛ jahiliw ani bɔgɔnaw dɔgɔ ani sariya. | Quran: (95:5)

name-23.instruction: Jɛtigi jɛli kɔrɔ la, o min bɛ mɔ̀gɔ sangariya, jɛ ani tɔgɔ jɛ dunya nin na ani kɔfɛ na. | Quran: (58:11)(6:83)

name-24.instruction: O min bɛ sangariya ani nɔgɔya diya. | Quran: (3:26)

name-25.instruction: O min bɛ se mɔ̀gɔ si dɔgɔya ani a nɔgɔya bɔ. | Quran: (3:26)

name-26.instruction: O min bɛ kuma wa kankan mɛn A masa na fɛn o fɛn na, ani O min bɛ A fɛn daw niniw mɛn ka u jaabi. | Quran: (2:127)(2:256)(8:17)(49:1)

name-27.instruction: O min ma fɛn si tɛ bɔ A la, nyɛ, kɛrɛnkɛrɛn wa yɔrɔ dɔɔni tɛ. | Quran: (4:58)(17:1)(42:11)(42:27)

name-28.instruction: A bɛ O min bɛ sariya ani a kɛ fɛn daw cɛ nin ani kɔfɛ na, A bɛ tiɲɛ kɛ fɛn daw cɛ, mɔ̀gɔ tɔ tɛ. | Quran: (22:69)

name-29.instruction: O min bɛ bana tɛtiɲɛ ani jahiliya kɛnɛ bɛɛ la. | Quran: (6:115)

name-30.instruction: O min bɛ A fɛn daw A nɔgɔya ani A ɲɛ di. | Quran: (6:103)(22:63)(31:16)(33:34)

name-31.instruction: A bɛ O min ma fɛn bɛɛ tiɲɛ tɛ dogo, o kɔrɔ ko fɛnw tiɲɛ; fɛn dɔɔni tɛ bɔ A la, fɛn bɛɛ tɛ a kɛrɛnkɛrɛn tɛ; a fɔ ko a bɛ se fɛn dogo O min bɛ fɛn bɛɛ da la, o bɛ ɲinina ani kafiriya. | Quran: (6:18)(17:30)(49:13)(59:18)

name-32.instruction: O min sabari bɛ jurubagaw kafiriyaw kan ka ca a miiri bɛɛ (a bɛ se ko u bena yafe). | Quran: (2:235)(17:44)(22:59)(35:41)

name-33.instruction: Tɔgɔ nin bɛ gɛlɛ a bamanankan na bawo a bɛ kuma caman kɔnɔ minw tɛ fɔtɔ spiritual na, nka a bɛ se ɲɛsin o cogo: 'Al-Adhīm' O min bɛ Bonba Sangariya ani Fantastik Cɛba ka ca fara yɛrɛ wa fɛn ɲɛsɩgɛ bɛɛ ma | Quran: (2:255)(42:4)(56:96)

name-34.instruction: O min bɛ yafe caya tuma caman. | Quran: (2:173)(8:69)(16:110)(41:32)

name-35.instruction: O min bɛ A a ni ce jira sinjibagaw ma, hali u baara nɔgɔya joli. | Quran: (35:30)(35:34)(42:23)(64:17)

name-36.instruction: O min bɛ sanja min A da dafalen na, a miiri tɛ. | Quran: (4:34)(31:30)(42:4)(42:51)

name-37.instruction: Cɛba: O min ka ca A fɛn daw ma, cɛba min A dɔrɔn b'a lɔn. | Quran: (13:9)(22:62)(31:30)

name-38.instruction: O min bɛ kana ani A ɲɛ mara. | Quran: (11:57)(34:21)(42:6)

name-39.instruction: kuma nin bɛ kɛrɛn arabuya kuma ɲininanw la; a bɛ gɛlɛ a bamanankan na hali sisanra arabuya na}. A bɛ fɔ: O min tɛ fɛn dɔɔni bila a sariya tuma, hali a dɔɔni ka ca. | Quran: (4:85)

name-40.instruction: A bɛ O min bena A fɛn daw baara bɛɛ jate ɲinina wa fili tɛ. | Quran: (4:6)(4:86)(33:39)

name-41.instruction: O min bɛ bana dafalen na a lajɛcogo A fɛn daw ma wa u kelenya A ma. | Quran: (55:27)(39:14)(7:143)

name-42.instruction: O min A fɛn daw datugu A dibaya la. | Quran: (27:40)(82:6)

name-43.instruction: O min bɛ lajɛ ani ye min A da (fɛn daw baaraw fana bɛ daw ye). | Quran: (4:1)(5:117)

name-44.instruction: O min bɛ A fɛn daw niniw jaabi n'A b'a fe ani mɔ̀gɔ min A b'a fe. | Quran: (11:61)

name-45.instruction: Tɔgɔ nin arabuya na kɔrɔ ko: caya ca, nka Ala ma a faamu ko A y'a jɔ bɛɛ fa ani A fɛn bɛɛ kɔnɔ cogo min A dɔrɔn b'a lɔn. | Quran: (2:268)(3:73)(5:54)

name-46.instruction: O min Hakili bɛ mɔ̀gɔ hakili ani dɔnni bɛɛ ɲɛ, ɲɛ, a bena ɲɛ. | Quran: (31:27)(46:2)(57:1)(66:2)

name-47.instruction: Kuma nin arabuya na kɔrɔ ko: O min bɛ ɲɛsin a nɛɛma ma nafe, nafɛ ani ɲɛ la, nka mɔ̀gɔ bɛ tɔgɔ nin kalan 'Kurana' na a bɛ kɔrɔ caman waati o waati minw bɛ gɛlɛ a kuma na}. An bɛ se a a: O min bɛ ɲɛsin A baaramɔ̀gɔw ma nafɛ la hali u bɛ tɛmɛ A la ani u t'A kumaɲi. | Quran: (11:90)(85:14)

name-48.instruction: O min bɛ sangariya kɔrɔ tɛ dan na, sisan ani tɛmɛtɛ. | Quran: (11:73)

name-49.instruction: O min bɛ tunanw wuli ani ɲɛnamaya caya min A b'a fe, mɔ̀gɔw, misiw wa dugukolo. | Quran: (22:7)

name-50.instruction: Seere: Ala bɛ seere banbaw ani dafalen ye fɛn bɛɛ min kɛra A masa na, jira jɛlen ani ɲɛlen, dafalen tɛ fili. | Quran: (4:166)(22:17)(41:53)(48:28)

name-51.instruction: O min bɛ Tiɲɛ dafalen mara. | Quran: (6:62)(22:6)(23:116)(24:25)

name-52.instruction: O min bɛ fɛn daw riziqi dafa ani O min ma fɛn si u kɛnɛ bɛɛ na tɛ dogo. | Quran: (3:173)(4:171)(28:28)(73:9)

name-53.instruction: Seba: Ala bɛ se ka ca, seba ka ca, A fanga dan tɛ, yɛrɛ fanga kɔlɔniw t'A fɔ. | Quran: (22:40)(22:74)(42:19)(57:25)

name-54.instruction: Tɛtigi: tɛya min bɛ A ma, dan tɛ, lɛrɛ tɛ, nɔgɔya si tɛ a kɛnɛ, jɔ tɛ, tɛmɛ tɛ, fɛn si tɛ a dɔɔni. | Quran: (51:58)

name-55.instruction: O min bɛ imanbaga baaramɔ̀gɔw mara, nabiw ani minw b'u kɔ u bɛ 'maralen mɔ̀gɔw' kɔrɔ la ko u lajɛra a ni ce wajib ma O min b'u sigi, o kɔrɔ ko Ala kan. | Quran: (4:45)(7:196)(42:28)(45:19)

name-56.instruction: O min bɛ a ni ce, sangariya ani kumaɲi fɛn tɔ kan ka ca. | Quran: (14:8)(31:12)(31:26)(41:42)

name-57.instruction: A bɛ bamanankan na ko jatebagatigi nka a kɔrɔ ko O min bɛ fɛn o fɛn, baara o baara, kɛtɛ o kɛtɛ jate A masa na, fɛn si tɛ bɔ A dɔnniya la. | Quran: (72:28)(78:29)(82:10-12)

name-58.instruction: O min bɛ daminɛ fɛn min tɛ, daminɛ tɛ, misali tɛ, o kɔrɔ ko O min bɛ fɛn daw da. | Quran: (10:34)(27:64)(29:19)(85:13)

name-59.instruction: O min bɛ ɲɛnamaya sa ɲɛnamaya kɔfɛ ani O min bɛ tunanw wuli tunan kɔfɛ. | Quran: (10:34)(27:64)(29:19)(85:13)

name-60.instruction: O min bɛ ɲɛnamaya maniyy jɛlen ma, o kɔrɔ ko seman ji, niyɔrɔ tɛ, a kɛ ɲɛnamaya fɛn ye ani O min bɛ ɲɛnamaya mɔ̀gɔw, jinew ani malaikaw yɛrɛw ma u niyɔrɔw ɲɔgɔn na wuli tuma. | Quran: (7:158)(15:23)(30:50)(57:2)

name-61.instruction: A bɛ O min bɛ ɲɛnamaya fɛnw sa ani O min bɛ sebaw fanga bɔ dunya nin na sa la. | Quran: (3:156)(7:158)(15:23)(57:2)

name-62.instruction: ɲɛnamayatigi: O min tɛ sigi nka A bɛ, O min bɛ hayah mara, jira nin tɛ ɲɛnamaya ye i ko fɛn daw hayah min bɛ niyɔrɔ, sanan ani mɔgɔ jɛlen na. Imam At-Tahawiyy kuma a laadali sɛbɛ na ko 'o min bɛ Ala jira kɛ kɔrɔ min bɛ mɔ̀gɔw ma, a bɛ kafiri' | Quran: (2:255)(3:2)(25:58)(40:65)

name-63.instruction: O min bɛ, tɛmɛtɛ ani a tɛ yɛlɛ, O min tɛmɛ wa bɔ tɛ, cogo si tɛ mɔ̀gɔw baaraw mara ani daw A kan. | Quran: (2:255)(3:2)(20:111)

name-64.instruction: O min tɛ fɛn mago ani o min tɛ se gɔsi, dɔɔni wa mago la. | Quran: (38:44)

name-65.instruction: O min ɲɛ ka fɛn tɔ bɛɛ ma ani O min bɛ nafa dan tɛ di ca, sara tɛ. | Quran: (11:73)

name-66.instruction: Kelen: O min tɛ ɲɔgɔn, A yɛrɛ la, A baara la, wa A jiraw la. Fɛn si tɛ i ko A. | Quran: (2:163)(5:73)(9:31)(18:110)

name-67.instruction: Kelen: O min bɛ kelenya jira ye. | Quran: (112:1)

name-68.instruction: O min an bɛ se jigi baara bɛɛ kan ani O min bɛ wele an mago bɛɛ ma; O min den wa ba tɛ, kelen wa kelen tɛ, Al-Hakim kɔlɔsili kan; O min tɛ fɛn mago ani O min fɛn bɛɛ b'a mago, u sigi kama, ani tɔ̀w. | Quran: (112:2)

name-69.instruction: O min nɔgɔya tɛ, O min fanga bɛ dafalen, fɛn daw bɛɛ mara, O min fɛn si tɛ nɔgɔya. | Quran: (6:65)(36:81)(46:33)(75:40)

name-70.instruction: O min bɛ se fɛn bɛɛ kan ani O min se dan tɛ dɔrɔn. | Quran: (18:45)(54:42)(54:55)

name-71.instruction: O min bɛ bana fɛn daw jiraw la ani ka ca fɛn dɔ bɛɛ ma; O min bɛ koow teliya lamɛn, fɛn dɔw teliya mɔ̀gɔw ɲɛ na cira kan, a bɛ fɛn o fɛn nafa, jeli, waati ani jiraw di minw bɛ A ma hakili kan | Quran: (16:61)(17:34)

name-72.instruction: O min bɛ bana fɛn daw jiraw la ani ka ca fɛn dɔ bɛɛ ma; o min bɛ koow kɔfɛya a fe, fɛn dɔw kɔfɛya mɔ̀gɔw ɲɛ na cira kan, a bɛ fɛn o fɛn nafa, jeli, waati ani jiraw di minw bɛ a ma hakili kan (a ka no 71 jira) | Quran: (71:4)

name-73.instruction: Fɔlɔ: O min bɛ fɛn daw tɛ, daminɛ tɛ ani waati tɛ; O min bɛ bana dali, jira kura bɔli ani yɛlɛma la, O min bɛ a sigi tɛ | Quran: (57:3)

name-74.instruction: Banbaw: O min bɛ tɛmɛ tɛ waati min fɛn daw bɛ bɔ waati o waati; O min bɛ tɛmɛ, O min bɛ bɔ ani A bɛ bana bɔli ani jira kelen wa caman bɔli la; o min bɛ a ban ani bɔ hakili tɛ | Quran: (57:3)

name-75.instruction: O min sigi bɛ jira fɛn bɛɛ na jiraw la, se ani mara fɛnw na, tɛ min bɛ yɛrɛ si na yɔrɔ, ja ani cogo fɛnw na | Quran: (57:3)

name-76.instruction: O min bɛ mara fɛn daw ɲininaw la minw bɛ a fe Datigi ma mɔ̀gɔ jiraw wa fɛn daw jiraw kɛ ani O min bɛ fɛn daw jiraw ani u jaw da | Quran: (57:3)

name-77.instruction: O min bɛ fɛn bɛɛ mara, a tila ani a mara ani O min bɛ fɛn bɛɛ da hakili kan | Quran: (13:11)(22:7)

name-78.instruction: O min bɛ bana fɛn daw jiraw la ani O min fanga fɛn daw kan dan tɛ | Quran: (13:9)

name-79.instruction: O min bɛ se eeman ani barikaw fɛn daw bɛɛ ma, u cɛ dɔw bɛ a ni ce dɔw tɛ: fɔlɔw bɛ wele musulmanw wa imanbagaw, tɔw bɛ wele kafiriw wa tɛ-imanbagaw. | Quran: (52:28)

name-80.instruction: O min bɛ yafe mɔ̀gɔ minw bɛ toba waati o waati u bɛ toba. | Quran: (2:128)(4:64)(49:12)(110:3)

name-82.instruction: O min bɛ juru bila ani a yafe ani O min bɛ da mara kɛnɛ jugu bɛɛ na sangariya, mara ani barikaw da wa toba sisanra da. | Quran: (4:99)(4:149)(22:60)

name-83.instruction: O min bɛ se nafa ca di sara tɛ mago tɛ. | Quran: (3:30)(9:117)(57:9)(59:10)

name-84.instruction: O min bɛ da ani a di cira kan masa bɛɛ, mara, nafolo ani fanga ca minw bɛ fɛn dɔw ma dunya nin na. | Quran: (3:26)

name-85.instruction: O kɔrɔ ko, Ala bɛ O min ɲɛ ka fɛn tɔ bɛɛ ma tiɲɛ na ani seere bɛɛ b'o dafa ani b'a kɔkɔrɔ bɔ, a tɛ tiɲɛ ko a sɔsɔ, a bɔ wa a jɛɲɔgɔnya. | Quran: (55:27)(55:78)

name-86.instruction: O min bɛ sariya tiɲɛ cɛba kan, O min bɛ bana tɛtiɲɛ ani jahiliya kɛnɛ bɛɛ la, O min sariya tɛ dɔrɔn. | Quran: (7:29)(3:18)

name-87.instruction: O min bena fɛn daw lajɛ don min na sɔsɔli tɛ, Sariya Don. | Quran: (3:9)

name-88.instruction: O min tɛ fɛn daw mago ani A fɛn daw tɛ se al-Ghaniyy [O min b'u sigi ani u mara u sigi na ani u yɛlɛma tuma bɛɛ] mago tɛ. | Quran: (3:97)(39:7)(47:38)(57:24)

name-89.instruction: O min bɛ fɛn daw magow dafa ani O min b'u riziqi u ma. | Quran: (9:28)

name-90.instruction: O min bɛ fɛn o fɛn seegaw, u maraw a fe ani O min ma u ka tuma bɛɛ mara cira kan. | Quran: (67:21)

name-91.instruction: O min bɛ se jugu min a fɛn ma cira kan. | Quran: (6:17)

name-92.instruction: O min bɛ se nafa min a fɛn ka sɔ cira kan. | Quran: (30:37)

name-93.instruction: Yeelen: O min bɛ minw lajɛ u kuntigi ma minw bɛ sɛni gɛlɛya na, a b'u kɛ sira tiɲɛ kan cira kan; Ala bɛ O min bɛ imanbagaw lajɛ eeman yeelen ma. | Quran: (24:35)

name-94.instruction: O min bɛ fɛn dɔw fe nafa u ka lajɛ ɲuman ani tiɲɛ dɔn. | Quran: (25:31)

name-95.instruction: O min bɛ fɛn daw ani dunya nin sigi, tɛ fɛn kɔlɔlen na wa misali kɔlɔ ja na, nka tɛ kɔmɔgɔ, misali ani fɛn min tɛ kɛ. | Quran: (2:117)(6:101)

name-96.instruction: O min sigi bɛ bana bɔli ani yɛlɛma la, o bɛ hakili ɲuman kan min tɛ se kɔkɔrɔ fɔ. | Quran: (55:27)

name-97.instruction: O min bɛ ani a tɛ yɛlɛ waati min fɛn daw bɛ bɔ. | Quran: (15:23)

name-98.instruction: O min bɛ fɛn daw lajɛ min b'u nafa ma ka ca. | Quran: (2:256)

name-99.instruction: O min bɛ jurubagaw sariya kɔfɛ a bɛ o o jate dafa fo don cira, a b'u nɔgɔya ani waati u ma fo waati min u bɛɛ t'a don lɔn. | Quran: (2:153)(3:200)(103:3)
